plugins.readme_text:
Trae2api-dsh

把 TRAE 账号的模型额度接入 dsh，直接在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用。

[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh?label=release)](https://github.com/FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh/releases/latest) [![CI](https://github.com/FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [English](README.en.md) · [下载](https://github.com/FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh/releases/latest) · [使用指南](docs/usage.zh-CN.md) · [问题反馈](https://github.com/FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh/issues) **Trae2api-dsh** 让 dsh 使用你在 TRAE CN / TRAE SOLO CN 账号中的模型额度。导入账号后，即可在 dsh 原生对话菜单选择 TRAE 模型和思考强度，使用该账号的额度进行对话。内嵌控制台提供多账号管理、自动签到、账号轮询、用量统计和模型显示设置。 [功能](#功能) · [界面](#界面预览) · [快速开始](#快速开始) · [日常使用](#日常使用) · [常见问题](#常见问题) · [项目文档](#项目文档) ## 功能 | 功能 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | **TRAE 额度接入** | 导入 TRAE 账号，在 dsh 中调用账号提供的模型并使用其模型额度。 | | **自动签到** | 按北京时间每日签到，跳过当天已签到账号；支持立即执行、上次与下次执行时间及结果查询。 | | **多账号管理** | 导入已登录的桌面账号或网页授权登录，切换当前账号，分别启用或禁用模型调用。 | | **账号轮询** | 在有效且启用的账号之间顺序轮询，或根据缓存的剩余积分排序调度。 | | **模型与思考强度** | 预置 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash，发现账号的 Remote / SOLO 模型，按实际能力提供 Low / High / Xhigh。 | | **模型显示管理** | 在控制台搜索、显示或隐藏模型，支持批量操作；刷新与重启后保留偏好，并同步至原生模型菜单。 | | **积分与用量** | 查看账号积分、Token、缓存、请求、消费记录和每日汇总。 | | **完整内嵌控制台** | 保留概览、账号与签到、消费记录、轮询与设置、模型测试；也可在浏览器新窗口打开。 | | **服务自动管理** | 首次准备后随 dsh 启动；完整退出、Host 结束或禁用插件时回收整个代理进程树。 | 自动签到和轮询默认关闭，可在控制台按需开启。关闭窗口到托盘时服务继续运行。 ## 界面预览 ![Trae2api-dsh 内嵌控制台](assets/embedded-console.png)
查看模型管理与思考强度菜单 ![发现模型并设置显示偏好](assets/model-catalog.png) ![dsh 原生模型与思考强度选择](assets/model-selection.png)
截图使用隔离测试数据；实际模型列表由账号返回。 ## 快速开始 ### 环境要求 | 环境 | 要求 | | --- | --- | | dsh | 已验证 **0.2.0-rc.2**，本机 Desktop / Web | | Node.js | **22+** | | Python | **3.10+**，包含 `venv` 和 `pip` | | 账号 | TRAE CN / TRAE SOLO CN，具有目标模型使用权限 | | 操作系统 | Windows 10/11；Linux 和 macOS 通过 CI 验证 | 本机 Web / CLI 安装需要 `pnpm` 10+；Desktop 使用自带的插件管理环境。首次准备需要联网下载 Python 依赖，无需 Docker。 ### 安装 **Desktop**：在 dsh 插件管理器的添加包入口输入以下地址，安装并启用后打开侧栏 **TRAE 控制台**。 ```text https://github.com/FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh/releases/latest/download/trae2api-dsh.tgz ``` **本机 Web / CLI**： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh/releases/latest/download/trae2api-dsh.tgz dsh web ``` 可在 [Release](https://github.com/FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh/releases/latest) 下载固定版本和 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。不同市场的收录情况见 [市场记录](MARKETPLACES.md)，未收录的市场可能限制安装来源。 ### 首次配置 1. 打开 **TRAE 控制台 → 服务设置**，点击 **准备环境**，完成后点击 **启动服务**。 2. 选择 **TRAE SOLO CN** 或 **Trae CN**，点击 **导入当前桌面账号**；也可返回控制台使用网页授权登录。 3. 在 **DSH 模型管理** 点击 **接入 dsh 模型菜单**。 4. 在对话输入框选择模型和思考强度；模型显示或隐藏仍在控制台中管理。 首次启动不会自动导入账号。导入由你主动触发，TRAE 客户端登录文件保持只读。模型名称、可选档位与可用额度以账号返回为准。 ## 日常使用 | 要做什么 | 控制台入口 | | --- | --- | | 添加、切换账号，设置模型调用开关 | **账号与签到** | | 设置每日签到或立即执行 | **账号与签到 → 自动签到** | | 开启顺序轮询或积分优先模式 | **轮询与设置 → 多账号轮询** | | 刷新模型、搜索、逐个或批量显示/隐藏 | **DSH 模型管理** | | 查看积分、Token 和消费记录 | **概览 / 消费记录** | | 准备环境、启动或停止代理 | 顶部 **服务设置** | 积分优先模式使用已缓存的余额排序，可先在账号页刷新积分。隐藏模型会从 dsh 的模型目录移除该项，请先切换仍在使用它的会话；隐藏全部后，重新显示任一模型即可恢复。 ## 运行与更新 插件使用独立 Python 环境和本机回环地址。准备完成后自动管理代理生命周期，保留其他供应商和全局模型默认值。账号副本、设置和显示偏好保存在插件自己的数据目录，更新会刷新运行文件并保留这些数据。 项目原名为 `dsh-trae-relay`。从旧包升级请先断开模型、停止并移除旧插件，再添加新包；数据目录和 credential 标识保持兼容。详细步骤见 [升级与数据管理](docs/usage.zh-CN.md#从旧包升级)。 ## 常见问题 **关闭 dsh 窗口会停止代理吗？** 关闭到托盘时继续运行；完整退出 dsh、Host 结束或禁用插件时停止代理和签到任务。 **为什么模型列表或思考档位不同？** 插件读取当前账号返回的目录。未提供的档位不会显示，没有公布思考档位的模型使用上游默认行为。切换账号后刷新目录即可。 **端口被占用或找不到 Python 怎么办？** 在服务设置中填写可用的 Python 完整路径，或停止服务后选择空闲端口重新准备。网络下载与环境排查见 [使用指南](docs/usage.zh-CN.md)。 **支持国际版或远程浏览器吗？** 当前面向中国版协议和本机 Desktop / Web。完整控制台使用 Host 回环地址，远程浏览器场景尚未支持。 **卸载会删除账号吗？** 卸载保留插件数据。先断开模型、停止服务；需要彻底清理时再按使用指南移除数据与 credential。 ## 项目文档 | 文档 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | [使用指南](docs/usage.zh-CN.md) | 详细配置、签到轮询、模型管理、存储、升级和卸载 | | [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md) | 目录结构、本地开发、隔离测试和发布流程 | | [版本记录](CHANGELOG.md) | 各版本的变更 | | [市场记录](MARKETPLACES.md) | 已上架渠道与待审申请 | CI 在 Windows、Ubuntu、macOS 上验证插件测试、真实 dsh 安装、模型同步和服务退出回收；测试使用合成账号，不涉及个人凭据或付费推理。欢迎通过 [Issues](https://github.com/FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh/issues) 报告问题。 --- 反代引擎和原有管理界面来自 [autumnsentiment/Trae2api-cn](https://github.com/autumnsentiment/Trae2api-cn) v1.0.4，保留上游版权与许可。相关说明：[MIT 许可](LICENSE) · [第三方说明](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) · [使用边界与免责声明](DISCLAIMER.md)。

plugins.description: VSCode-style remote SSH development for DSH: host manager, helper deploy pipeline, remote files/terminal/git, transparent remote execution.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-remote-vs · DSH 远程开发（VSCode 式）

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](./LICENSE)

中文 | [English](./README.en.md)

Host 进程内的 SSH 主机管理 + helper 推送流水线 + **VS Code 式远端工作台**
（资源管理器 / 搜索 / 源代码管理 / 提交图 / 多标签编辑器 / 并排 Diff / 多终端）。
主机配在 DSH 设置里（“远程主机”项）；装了 `dsh-better-sidebar` 时另有
独立“远程”tab，没装则退到原生右侧栏“远程”页（同内容，引导页自助开，per-session 实例）。
编辑器还额外挂到会话视图槽，与“对话 / 轨迹”并列成一个**远程编辑器**标签，
这样代码区是整屏宽的；右侧栏那份是窄屏备用面。
P2 起原生工具在远端工作区里透明跑远端（见下）。

```text
┌─ 本机 DSH Host ─────────────────────────────────┐
│  本插件 Host 半      │  Client 半（浏览器）     │
│  主机/密钥/推送/路由 │  设置两节 + 原生入口接管 │
│  /api/dsh-remote/*   │  工作台（右侧栏 + 会话视图）│
└──────────────────────┴──────────────────────────┘
       │ ssh2（文件/进程/终端）+ helper RPC（远端 fs）
       ▼
┌─ 远端 Linux ─────────────────────────────────┐
│  ~/.dsh-helpers/<ver>/<arch>/dsh-ssh-helper  │
│  用户指定的远端工作目录                        │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-remote-vs
```

（从 npm 装，推荐；也可以直接跟仓库装：`dsh plugin --profile web add github:xiray-xia/dsh-remote-vs`。）

要求 DSH `0.2.1-alpha.3` 及以上（`engines.dsh` 门到底；**当前实测基线 `0.2.1-rc.2`**）。
`--profile web` 指明装进哪个 profile —— 本插件是 Web 插件，
必须装进 Web GUI 所用的那个（`web` 是常见命名，以你自己的 profile 名为准）。

**这一条命令就够了，不需要放行任何构建脚本**：包本身没有 `prepare`/`postinstall`，依赖树里也没有任何
带安装脚本的包（`ssh2` 是**打进产物**的，不是依赖）；走仓库安装时还带着构建好的 `lib/`。
以前需要「在 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里放行构建脚本后重跑」，那是 pnpm 12 对
「带安装脚本的依赖」的硬策略门（`ERR_PNPM_GIT_DEP_PREPARE_NOT_ALLOWED` / `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`），
依赖侧无法豁免，只能从树里消掉。装完重启 `dsh web`，打开设置 → 远程主机开配。

> 包内含预编译的 helper（`vendor/dsh-remote-helpers/`，约 45 MB），所以首次安装下载量偏大 ——
> 它是**唯一**的 helper 投放渠道（官方 Release 不带 helper 可执行文件），去掉它就没法给新主机部署。

## 能力

### 远端工作台（VS Code 式 UI）

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 资源管理器 | 懒加载目录树 + 展开折叠 + 隐藏文件开关；右键菜单：新建/改名/删除/复制/移动/粘贴/在此文件夹查找/插入 `@` 引用；git 状态色与文件夹聚合标记 |
| 搜索 | 两档：**文件名**（远端 `find`）与**内容**（远端 `grep`）。内容档带范围目录、`Aa`（大小写）/`ab_`（全字）/`.*`（正则）、结果按文件分组、命中高亮，点条目跳到该行 |
| 源代码管理 | **仓库目录选择器**（工作区里的 git 在子目录时用：浏览远端目录、一键跳到工作区内发现的仓库、手输相对/绝对路径，并逐目录提示会落在哪个仓库）；变更/暂存/未跟踪/忽略分桶，**未跟踪目录行可点击展开**，逐文件与**逐 hunk** 暂存/还原、丢弃（带确认）、提交；分支/远程/stash 面板；同步（fetch/pull/push） |
| 会话改动审阅 | 输入框上方的**可收纳**面板，按**会话**列出改了什么（一行一个文件、文件类型图标、右侧 `+a −b`）；点文件在远程编辑器里打开并画**整行着色 + 行内字符级差异**，右上角 `n/N ↑↓` 跳改动点，悬浮改动行可**撤销**这处改动（远端 `git apply -R`）。详见下文「会话改动审阅」 |
| 并排 Diff | 左右**严格等分** + 中间 gutter 逐 hunk 按钮 + **顶部横向滚动条**（一行很长也不会破坏对称）+ 行号钉在左侧，**只渲染视口内的行**（3000 行文件从 9000 个行容器降到约 174 个，滚动范围与整篇渲染完全一致）；可切「变更前 / 变更后」，变更后可编辑并保存 |
| 提交图 | SVG 分支/合并图 + 提交详情 + 点击提交展开变更文件 + 进文件看 diff |
| 多标签编辑器 | 打开/保存/重载、脏标记、多文件标签并存；图片预览、Markdown/HTML 预览（源码/预览切换） |
| 语法高亮 | VS Code **Dark+ / Light+** 配色；覆盖 java/aidl/smali、c/c++、go、rust、js/ts、json、py、yaml、xml、html/css、md、sh、properties/rc/toml、diff 等；**兜底着色器**在语法包没命中时自动接管，不会出现整篇无色。诚实说明：kotlin / gradle / smali 用 Java 语法着色（没有专用语法包），效果是关键字/字符串/注释正确、专有语法不细分 |
| 查找 | 编辑器内 `Ctrl+F`（`Aa`/`ab_`/`.*`、`3/17` 计数、↑↓、`F3`/`Shift+F3`、`Esc`）；**选中文本按 `Ctrl+F` 直接填入**；查找框钉在右上角，滚动不带走 |
| 跳转 | 从搜索结果点进文件 → 跳到该行 + 垂直居中 + **落地行高亮**（约 2.6 秒后淡出）；同文件反复跳都生效 |
| 多终端 | 标签式多终端（`+` 新建、`✕`/中键关闭带确认）、可跨主机；刷新页面按 session id 自动重连回原会话，**socket 全断开后会话保留 10 分钟**（够刷新、够切浏览器标签页接回），超时才关闭远端 shell |
| 工作区 | 绑定列表 + 路由档位下拉 + 新建工作区双模向导（本地 / 远端） |

### 主机与通道

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 主机管理 | 增删改查、连接测试；证书 / 密码认证；配置存 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-remote.json`（0600），与 `dsh-ssh.json` 独立 |
| 密钥 bootstrap | 密码主机一键生成专用密钥对并下发 `authorized_keys`，之后走密钥 |
| 推送流水线 | 远端 arch/系统探测 → 版本比对 → 一致跳过 / 否则推送；executable 通道推送自编译 helper。失败后不再每次远端文件操作都重试：按 **5 秒起步、上限 5 分钟**的退避重试，设置页「推送」按钮可强制立即重试 |
| 远端文件 | SFTP 浏览 / 读 / 写 / 新建 / 删除 / 改名。边界已加固：0 字节文件不再卡死，每个 SFTP 操作 60s 超时回收通道；**单个目录列表上限 20000 条**（按"目录在前、其余按名"排序后取前 20000，宿主日志说明——协议里没有"已截断"字段，界面上没有标记） |
| 远端终端 | ssh2 PTY + WebSocket，xterm 渲染（复制粘贴/主题跟随/刷新重连）；**重新挂接只接管、不改尺寸**（刷新页面不会把运行中的 shell 缩成 80×24）；输出积压时对远端施加真背压；**单帧上限 1 MiB**，超过 64 Ki 字符的粘贴在客户端按码点分块发送，不再撑断连接 |
| 并发通道 | 每主机同时最多 **6 条**远端通道（不再撞远端 sshd 的 `MaxSessions`）；第 7 个排队最多等 **30 秒**，超时明确报 `remote host <alias> is busy`，而不是无限堆连接 |
| 超时与进程清理 | exec 跑在独立会话里（`setsid --wait`），超时先发 TERM、**3 秒后升级 KILL**，连同子进程一起收掉；远端没有 `setsid --wait` 时探测一次即知，退回旧行为并在宿主日志里写明"超时可能没停掉远端命令" |
| Git 图谱 | 远端仓库状态 + 分支 + SVG 提交图 + 提交详情（exec + 前端解析，零 Host 增量）|
| 导入 | 从 `~/.ssh/config`、从现有 `dsh-ssh.json` 一键导入（只读一次，不耦合）|

### Agent 能力

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| Agent 工具 | `remote_hosts` / `remote_exec` / `remote_read` / `remote_write` / `remote_ls` |
| **P2 透明远端执行** | 远端工作区里原生 `read/write/edit/bash/glob/grep/jobs` 直接跑在远端 |
| **P3 远端 @ 引用** | 远端会话 `@` 出远端文件候选（路由 fileReferences，scoped 实时/bare 走远端 rg 索引） |

## 工程结构

```text
dsh_remote_vs/
├── cordis.patch.yml        # 组合声明：插件行 + 私有本地 realm + 三路由 + preset-remote
├── src/
│   ├── index.ts            # 插件入口：store/pool/worlds/路由/工具/预设切换接线
│   ├── protocol.ts         # 前后端 wire 契约（路由表 + 纯类型，两边共用）
│   ├── paths.ts            # $DSH_HOME 下四件套寻址（库/密钥/构建缓存/别名目录）
│   ├── store.ts            # 主机 + 绑定 + 墓碑持久化（0600 JSON，原子写）
│   ├── pool.ts             # ssh2 长连接池（exec/shell/sftp/putFile，TOFU 主机键）
│   ├── sftp.ts             # 远端文件引擎（SFTP 窗口读写/目录树操作）
│   ├── keygen.ts           # 密码机密钥 bootstrap（生成→下发→翻转）

│       ├── index.tsx       # 双面决策（better 优先/settle 加速/原生兜底）+ 设置两节 + directoryFlow 双槽接管

│       ├── RemoteEditorView.tsx # 会话视图挂载面（与 对话/轨迹 并列的「远程编辑器」标签，整屏宽）

│       ├── SearchView.tsx       # 搜索面板：文件名 / 内容 两档 + Aa/ab_/.* + 分组结果 + 跳转
│       ├── EditorPane.tsx       # 编辑器面板：多标签 + 信息栏（构建戳/tok 计数）+ 图片/MD/HTML 预览

plugins.description: DSH 1.5 上下文治理：折叠工具结果、保持提示词缓存命中、接管宿主可写请求（不再需要 dsh-llm 文件补丁）。仅支持 DSH 1.5，后续会跟进更新。 / Context governance for DSH 1.5: folds tool results, keeps the prompt cache warm, takes over the writable-request path. DSH 1.5 only; newer releases will follow.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-context-reclaim **Tool results are reclaimed before they enter history, so the prompt cache never goes cold.** > ⚠️ **DSH 1.5 only** (`>=0.1.5-rc.2 <0.2.0`). Newer DSH releases will be supported in follow-up updates. > 🟢 **Collision risk: very low.** It occupies **5 server-side seams and 0 client slots** — measured alongside the **19 same-track plugins** among the 44 installed here, with no conflict, and it takes **no `chain` slot** (the only kind that makes plugins displace each other). See [Compatibility](#compatibility). [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-1.5-8a2be2.svg)](#compatibility) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-desktop%20%7C%20web-lightgrey.svg)](#compatibility) **English** · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- ## What this is A DSH session's context is not blown up by the conversation; it is blown up by **tool results**: a single `read` of several hundred lines, a single `pwsh` dumping a wall of logs, a system prompt repeated verbatim every turn. Once this content has entered the history, the only thing left is for the compactor to operate on it after the fact — and compaction has to rewrite already-committed history, which knocks out the whole server-side prefix cache and makes every compaction more expensive than the last. `dsh-context-reclaim` moves to a different position: it handles them **before the tool result is appended to history**, and it never rewrites content that has already been committed. So the prefix cache is never invalidated because of this plugin. It hooks into 5 seams: | Seam | What it does | Default | |---|---|---| | `tools/post-execute` | Purify a tool result the moment it is produced + bound it by content type, inserting a retrieval pointer at the truncation point | on | | `system-prompt/assemble` | Fold the tool definition surface, stabilize the order of prefix sections, truncate over-long description lines | on | | `tools/pre-execute` | Duplicate-edit interception (a second identical edit to the same content of the same file is rejected outright) | on | | `session/event` | Compaction-summary integrity audit (warns when a compaction summary is missing sections) | on | | `llm/stream` | One cost-attribution line per request, printing route / prompt / cache hit / output | on | --- ## 1. Tool-result purification and bounding This is the core. Every time a tool call returns, the plugin first performs **lossless purification**, then **bounding**. ### Lossless purification Collapses ANSI escape sequences, strips trailing whitespace, normalizes CR. This step is pure purification and loses no information. It only acts when the content meets **both** thresholds: length ≥ 32 characters, and a reduction ratio after purification ≥ 0.2%. Small results are not touched at all. Turn it off: `config.noise = false`, or the environment variable `DSH_RECLAIM_NOISE=0`. ### Bounding by content type Different types of tool results have completely different tolerances. The plugin sorts tools into three classes: | Class | Tools covered | Head / tail kept | Per-line cap | Total character cap | |---|---|---|---|---| | **Read-only** | `read` `grep` `glob` `codegraph_*` `lsp_*` | 80 lines / 12 lines | 512 | 160 | | **Side-effecting** | `pwsh` `bash` `docker_*` `job_output` | 40 lines / 40 lines | 1024 | 256 | | **Faithful** | `web_fetch` `web_search` `knowledge_*` `read_image` `pilot_snapshot` | left exactly as-is | — | — | Tools it does not recognize are treated as **faithful** — better to save nothing than to cause unintended damage. Wherever content was truncated, a retrieval pointer is inserted telling you how much of the original is left and how it can be retrieved, rather than dropping it silently. The trigger threshold for bounding is "saves more than 5%"; if it does not save much, nothing is touched. Turn it off: `config.bounded = false`, or the environment variable `DSH_RECLAIM_BOUNDED=0`. > **About oversized results**: content above `config.maxInlineBytes` (default 50000) is handed to the spill mechanism to be written to disk. This requires the spill plugin to be installed in your profile — without it, this threshold has no effect and over-limit content passes through unchanged. ### The faithful allowlist The lists for all three tool classes can be replaced wholesale in the configuration: ```yaml - id: reclaim config: readOnlyTools: ['read', 'grep', 'glob'] # a full-table replacement, not an append sideEffectTools: ['pwsh', 'bash'] faithfulTools: ['web_fetch', 'web_search'] ``` Note that this is a **full-table replacement**, not a per-field merge — writing only `headLines` will lose the character caps. Either write the whole table or write none of it. --- ## 2. Tool definition surface folding At the start of every session, DSH stuffs the complete definitions (name, description, parameter schema) of every available tool into the system prompt. With dozens of plugins installed, this block can account for a large proportion of it, while most of those tools will not be used at all in the current turn. By default the plugin **folds** this part: it keeps the full definitions of the most frequently used tools and compresses the rest into a one-line list (name + one-line description, no parameter schema). **A folded tool is still callable.** The one-line list only removes the schema from the prompt — the tool itself stays registered with the host, so the model can still find it with `search_tools`, call it straight away with `invoke_tool`, or make it resident again with `load_plugin`. There is no `load_tools` tool; `search_tools` + `invoke_tool` is the pair. If you would rather keep every schema in the prompt, turn the folding off (next line). Turn it off: `config.foldTools = false`, or the environment variable `DSH_RECLAIM_TOOL_FOLD=0`. --- ## 3. Prefix stabilization A server-side prefix cache only hits when the **prefix is byte-for-byte unchanged**. Yet the system prompt inherently carries a pile of things that change every turn: token counts, timestamps, session sequence numbers. By default the plugin flattens these volatile numbers and reorders the sections so that stable sections come first and volatile ones last. Each reorder prints one `[reclaim/section-order]` line in the log, telling you which sections were moved. --- ## 4. Truncating over-long description lines The system prompt occasionally contains a single exceptionally long description line (long comments written by some plugins). Lines above the threshold (not exposed in `config`; the environment variable `DSH_RECLAIM_PROMPT_LINE_MAX`, default 120 characters) are truncated, and the line numbers that were truncated are printed to the log. --- ## 5. Duplicate-edit interception If the model issues exactly the same modification to the same content of the same file twice in a row, the second one is intercepted and an explanation is returned — such a call is almost certainly a meaningless duplicate that burns a whole round trip for nothing. Log line: `[reclaim/dedup-deny]`. Turn it off: the environment variable `DSH_RECLAIM_DEDUP_DENY=0`. --- ## 6. Compaction-summary integrity audit If the summary produced by the compactor is truncated by the output budget, it **silently** becomes shorter — you receive no notice at all, the next turn simply starts with a piece of the context missing. After every compaction the plugin audits whether the summary contains the structural sections it should have, and warns when any are missing: ``` [reclaim/summary-audit] ⚠️ 摘要缺 3/8 段 ``` It **only warns, it does not modify the summary**. What actually prevents summaries from being truncated is [`dsh-aux-degrade`](#-with-dsh-aux-degrade-the-context-governance-pair--install-both-together); see the interaction section below. --- ## 7. Cost attribution One line is printed at the end of every request: ``` [reclaim/usage] route=aux prompt=12043 hit=11890 miss=153 out=204 purpose=compaction ``` `hit` / `miss` are the prefix-cache hit and miss character counts, and `purpose` is the purpose

plugins.description: deepseek鲸鲸桌宠，不是dsh插件，但是能管理dsh任务，依托于飞书进行远程任务控制
plugins.readme_text:
# 鲸鲸桌宠 v1.1.0 一只住在桌面上的蓝色鲸鱼娘。透明、无边框、会眨眼、会摆呆毛、会甩尾巴， 饿了自己偷吃白饭，闲了冒两句台词，想说话就双击她。 程序是纯 Python + PySide6 写的，Windows 上跑；不要安装、不要管理员权限， 双击就出来，右键就能设置。 **这一版新增了什么** → [RELEASE_NOTES.md](RELEASE_NOTES.md)　·　 完整改动史 → [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) --- ## 一、怎么跑起来 ### 方式一：exe 压缩包（推荐给不想装 Python 的人） 解压 `鲸鲸桌宠_分享版_v1.1.0_exe.zip`，得到 `WhalePet\` 文件夹， 双击里面的 `WhalePet.exe`。 - **整个文件夹要一起留着**：`WhalePet.exe` 旁边的 `_internal\` 是运行时，删了就起不来。 - 第一次运行会被 Windows 防火墙/SmartScreen 问一句（没有代码签名，属正常），选"仍要运行"。 - 想开机自启：把 `WhalePet.exe` 的快捷方式丢进 `%APPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup`。 ### 方式二：直接跑源码 ```bat pip install -r requirements.txt python whale_pet.py ``` 需要 Python 3.10 以上（开发与打包用的是 3.13）。 命令行参数（都能不带，用默认值就很好看）： ```bat python whale_pet.py --height 420 :: 角色高度（像素） python whale_pet.py --fps 30 :: 降帧率省电 python whale_pet.py --pos 1200,600 :: 固定初始位置 python whale_pet.py --no-ai :: 不读配置、不联网，纯桌面宠物 python whale_pet.py --version :: 打印版本号 python whale_pet.py --selftest :: 离屏自检（不弹窗口） python whale_pet.py --doctor :: 对外通道体检（飞书 / 派活逐项真测） ``` --- ## 二、她都会什么 | 操作 | 效果 | |---|---| | 左键单击 | 换个表情（切过去就保持住，不会自己收回去） | | 拖拽 | 换位置（位置会记住） | | 双击 | 打开聊天窗口（接大模型聊天，需要配 API key） | | 右键 | 菜单：说句话 / 显示时钟 / 做个表情 / 叫醒去睡觉 / 回到待机 / 派活给 Harness / 切换形态 / 设置 / 隐藏 | | 点饭碗 | 喂她白饭（吃完自动添） | - **精力 / 饱食度**：聊天会消耗精力，耗尽了会自己趴下睡；睡够了自己醒。 - **记账**：右键「小鲸鱼记账…」，按 DeepSeek 余额观测推算"今日已用"，含峰谷价。 - **提醒**：跟她说"25 分钟后叫我"，或"十月二十号早上提醒我跑步"，两种都支持， 后者存文件、关掉程序也不丢。 - **音效**：按键、喂饭、任务结束、提醒都有声，音量和逐事件开关在「设置 → 音效」。 - **隐藏**：右键 → 隐藏，程序缩进系统托盘；托盘图标右键「打开」请回来，「退出」才是真退出。 --- ## 三、设置（右键 →「设置…」） 六页，改完即生效，都落在 exe 旁边的 `whale_pet_config.json`： | 页 | 内容 | |---|---| | 聊天与钥匙 | 选模型厂商（DeepSeek / 通义 / 智谱 / Moonshot / OpenAI / 本地 Ollama）、填 API key、联网搜索开关 | | 飞书接入 | App ID / Secret、域名（feishu / lark）、白名单、允许派活 | | 音效 | 总开关、音量、逐事件开关、试听 | | 桌宠 | 大小、是否始终置顶 | | 界面 | 各窗口统一字号 | | 关于 | 版本、数据目录、配置文件路径 | 不想用界面也行，直接改 `whale_pet_config.json`（明文 JSON，密钥会用 Windows DPAPI 加密存储）。 --- ## 四、飞书接入（可选） 接上飞书以后，可以在手机或飞书里给她发消息、派活、让她发截图和结果文档。 1. 去 [飞书开放平台](https://open.feishu.cn/app) 建一个「企业自建应用」。 2. 拿到 `App ID` / `App Secret`，填进「设置 → 飞书接入」。 3. 开放平台里打开**长连接**方式的事件订阅（本程序自己实现协议，只依赖 `websockets`， 不需要公网 IP、不需要内网穿透、不开任何端口）。 4. 权限至少给：接收消息、发消息、上传图片、上传文件（发图片/文档要用）。 5. 建议填上「只认这个人的消息」（自己的 open_id）：不填的话私聊照常，但**群消息一律忽略**。 6. 勾「启用飞书接入」保存。桌宠控制台会打一行 `[飞书] 已连接`。 常用命令（直接发给她）：`/status` `/shot`（截屏发给你）`/task`（派活） `/sessions`（列出任务对话）。完整清单发 `/help`。 > 「允许飞书派活」等于**允许能给她发消息的人在这台电脑上执行代码**， > 默认关闭，自己掂量着开。 --- ## 五、派活给 Harness（可选） 「派活给 Harness」走 DeepSeek Harness 的 ACP 通道，让桌宠把一件事交给本机的 Harness 去做（写代码、查资料、跑命令），结果回到桌宠的气泡里。 - 前提：本机装了 DeepSeek Harness。 - 程序会自动在 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\`、 `%PROGRAMFILES%\DeepSeek Harness\` 下找主程序；装在别处就在 `whale_pet_config.json` 里把 `dsh_exe` 指过去。 - 没装的话这个菜单项点了会说一句"没找到"，不影响其它功能。 --- ## 六、三种形态 | 形态 | 说明 | |---|---| | 鲸鲸娘（默认） | 全身女仆装，有 16 种表情、眨眼、睡姿、呆毛和尾巴两层独立摆动 | | 哦鲸鲸 | 立绘特写，一张静态图，点了会尖叫一声并弹余额 | | DS鲸鱼娘（Live2D） | 会跟着鼠标转眼珠、表情能叠加的第三形态。**exe 包里已经带了**；跑源码的话要额外 `pip install live2d-py PyOpenGL`，没装就自动藏起这个形态 | 三个形态的显示高度各自记住，互不影响。切换到第三形态要等一两秒（它要先建 GL 上下文）。 > ⚠ **第三形态不是原创素材。** Live2D「DS鲸鱼娘」是第三方作品：模型制作 B站 **@氵六青** > （UID 11272072），形象版权 **@上善无形** 与 **@ZipZipPin**，采用 **CC BY-NC-SA 4.0**。 > 禁止出售、禁止以商业利益为主要目的使用；再分发须保留署名并以相同许可共享。 > 完整署名与改动说明见 [CREDITS.md](CREDITS.md)，程序内见「设置 → 关于 → 版权与致谢」。 --- ## 七、数据都存在哪 全部放在 **exe（或 `whale_pet.py`）旁边**，搬家时整个文件夹一起搬就行： | 文件 | 内容 | |---|---| | `whale_pet_config.json` | 配置（第一次保存设置时才生成；密钥 DPAPI 加密） | | `whale_pet_state.json` | 精力 / 饱食度 / 是否睡着 | | `chat_log.jsonl` | 最近三天的对话（更早的自动清） | | `memory.jsonl` | 长期记忆 | | `alarm.jsonl` | 长期提醒 | | `ledger.jsonl` | 余额观测账本 | | `feishu_log.txt` | 飞书连接日志（最近几十行） | 想恢复出厂：退出程序，把这些文件删掉即可（`whale_pet_config.json` 删掉就只有默认配置）。 --- ## 八、重新打包 ```bat pip install -r requirements.txt pyinstaller --noconfirm --clean WhalePet_onedir.spec ``` 产物在 `dist\WhalePet\`，整个文件夹压缩后分发。 **不要把源码（`.py`）放进分发包**：onedir 包里只有 `.pyc` 与资源文件。 `--selftest` / `--doctor` 在打包后同样可用，GUI 版没有控制台，用 `--selftest-log <文件>` / `--doctor-log <文件>` 把结果写出来： ```bat WhalePet.exe --selftest --selftest-log 自检.log WhalePet.exe --doctor --doctor-log 体检.log ``` 退出码 0 = 全通过。 --- ## 九、常见问题 **双击没反应？** 先看有没有已经在跑（同一台机器只允许一只鲸鲸，再双击一次等于把她请回前台）。 还不行就命令行跑 `WhalePet.exe --doctor --doctor-log 体检.log` 看缺什么。 **她不理我？** 没填 API key 时她只会冒台词、不会聊天，这是设计如此（不留半死不活的中间态）。 **画面糊了？** 在「设置 → 桌宠」里拖一下大小滑块即可：重新读原图重采样，比放大旧图清楚。 **杀毒软件报毒？** PyInstaller 打的未签名 exe 常被误报，源码可查、可自行重打包。 **关掉之后弹「已停止工作」？** 这是**安装路径含中文**时的已知问题：功能全部正常、 日志与配置都已落盘，只是进程退出那一刻会在两个 C/C++ 扩展（Cubism Native / PyOpenGL） 的静态析构里崩掉。解压到**纯英文路径**（如 `D:\WhalePet\`）即可完全避免。 v1.0.1 也有同样表现，不是这一版引入的；细节见 [RELEASE_NOTES.md](RELEASE_NOTES.md)。 --- ## 十、许可与素材 ### 10.1 程序代码 本项目自己写的 Python 代码可自由使用、修改、再分发。 ### 10.2 美术素材分两类 | 类别 | 文件范围 | 权利状态 | |---|---|---| | 自绘 / AI 生成 | `assets/` 下**除 `forms/l2d/` 以外**的立绘、表情帧、白饭碗、音效 | 由作者提供，随本程序 **as-is** 附带，不单独授予再许可 | | **第三方作品** | `assets/forms/l2d/`（第三形态「DS鲸鱼娘」） | **不是本项目原创**，单独遵循下节的许可 | > 早先的版本把这两类写成一句"美术素材由作者提供或使用 AI 工具生成"， > 对 Live2D 那部分是**错的**（它既不是自绘也不是 AI 生成），已更正。 ### 10.3 第三形态「DS鲸鱼娘」—— CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 | 项目 | 内容 | |---|---| | 作品 | 「DS鲸鱼娘」Live2D 模型 | | **模型制作** | B站 **@氵六青**（UID 11272072） | | **形象版权** | **@上善无形** 与 **@ZipZipPin** | | 来源 | 作者无偿分享的 Live2D 素材包（`DS鲸鱼娘 / DS鼠控版`） | | **许可** | **CC BY-NC-SA 4.0**（署名 — 非商业性使用 — 相同方式共享）
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/deed.zh | | **改动说明** | 仅**重建** `model3.json` 里的 `Motions` / `Expressions` 注册表（原包这两个字段是空的，绑定信息在 VTube Studio / 直播姬的配置里）。`moc3`、两张纹理、`physics3.json`、动作与表情文件**逐字节未改**。 | | 使用限制 | **禁止出售**；NC 条款禁止「以商业利益为主要目的」的使用；再分发须**保留本署名**并以相同许可共享 | 原包自带的《使用须知》原文：允许「商用直播」「自印物料」，同时明确 **「禁止任何形式的盗用以及出售」**，并说明 CC 官方 FAQ 认可"收取制作/运营成本等合理费用 不必然构成商业性使用"。 完整署名另见 [CREDITS.md](CREDITS.md)；程序内见「设置 → 关于 → 版权与致谢」。 若权利人认为某处用得不对，请联系作者，核实后会立刻替换或移除。

plugins.description: ZY-Agents 是单租户自托管的企业级多智能体平台，采用管理面与执行面分离的架构：主服务负责认证、编排与数据，内核宿主负责 Agent 运行时与本地工具执行。
plugins.readme_text:
# ZY-Agents ZY-Agents 是单租户自托管的企业级多智能体平台，采用**管理面与执行面分离**的架构：主服务负责认证、编排与数据，内核宿主负责 Agent 运行时与本地工具执行。 ## 架构概览 ``` ┌───────────────┐ ┌────────────────┐ │ apps/web │ │ apps/admin │ │ Vue3 用户端 │ │ Vue3 管理端 │ └──────┬────────┘ └───────┬────────┘ │ HTTP (REST) │ └─────────┬──────────┘ ▼ ┌─────────────────────┐ │ services/api │ │ FastAPI 业务面 │ │ 认证 / 编排 / 知识库 │ │ 技能 / 配额 / 审计 │ └─────┬─────────┬─────┘ │ │ model gateway tool gateway ← 双网关（HMAC 签名回调） │ │ ▼ ▼ ┌─────────────────────────┐ │ services/kernel-host │ │ Node.js DSH 执行面 │ │ Runtime Profile 内容寻址│ │ 回合循环 / 工具桥 / 审验 │ │ 审批 / 事件日志 │ └───────────┬─────────────┘ │ 本地 Agent 配对 ▼ ┌────────────────┐ │ 本地 Agent │ │ CLI + Chromium │ └────────────────┘ ``` ## 核心特性 - **回合制 Agent 编排** — 管理面下发任务，执行面按回合循环驱动模型与工具，状态可恢复 - **知识库检索** — 全文检索起步，可扩展嵌入与重排 - **技能注入** — 技能以 Runtime Profile 内容寻址方式进入 Agent 上下文 - **审批 broker** — 敏感工具调用经人工审批后执行 - **事件日志全链路** — 每个回合、每次工具调用均可追溯 - **白标 / 品牌化** — 展示层品牌（名称 / logo / 主题色）按部署配置，与契约层隔离 - **本地 Agent 配对** — CLI + 独立 Chromium 的本地执行，适配内网无 API 的存量系统 ## 快速开始 ### 前置依赖 - Python >= 3.11（主服务） - Node.js >= 22（内核宿主与前端构建） - MongoDB 与 Redis（本地开发可用 `make mongo-up` / `make redis-up` 拉起，或使用系统安装的实例） ### 启动步骤 ```bash # 1. 生成 .env 密钥（JWT、双网关签名、签名 URL 等） make bootstrap # 2. 编辑 .env，配置 OpenAI 兼容模型服务： # MODEL_PROVIDER_BASE_URL=... # MODEL_PROVIDER_API_KEY=... # MODEL_PROVIDER_MODEL=... # 3. 初始化数据库（索引 + 种子账号 + 服务端工具目录，幂等可重复执行） make mongo-up make redis-up make init-db # 4. 一键启动全部服务（api / kernel / web + mongo / redis） make dev ``` > 说明：数据库初始化也可以跳过（API 首次启动时会自动完成同样的初始化，全部幂等）；`make init-db` 的价值是**启动前显式完成并可查看初始化结果**（打印种子账号写入数、集合文档数）。本地运行数据（Mongo 数据文件、`data/`、`.localdata/`）不进仓库，git 跟踪列表只含源码与文档。 启动后访问 **http://127.0.0.1:4173**（用户端）。各服务端口：主服务 API `127.0.0.1:8000`、内核宿主 `127.0.0.1:8101`、用户端 `127.0.0.1:4173`。 停止服务：`make down`；查看日志：`make logs`。 ### 种子账号 首次启动且用户集合为空时，自动创建三个演示账号（用户名固定，**密码由环境变量注入、不落代码**）： | 用户名 | 角色 | 密码变量 | |---|---|---| | `admin` | 管理员 | `SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD` | | `ops` | 运维（受限管理） | `SEED_OPS_PASSWORD` | | `member` | 普通成员 | `SEED_MEMBER_PASSWORD` | 首次部署前在 `.env` 中配置这三个密码；生产部署务必修改或删除这些账号。 ### 配置说明 - 全部环境变量模板见 [.env.example](.env.example)，每个变量均带注释说明用途与默认值。 - JWT、双网关签名等密钥由 `deploy/bootstrap/generate-secrets.sh` 自动生成（`make bootstrap` 调用），请勿手工编造、勿入库。 ## 项目结构 ``` ZY-Agents/ ├── services/api/ # FastAPI 主服务（业务面：认证、编排、知识库、技能、双网关） ├── services/kernel-host/ # Node.js 22 DSH 内核宿主（执行面：回合循环、工具桥、审批、事件日志） ├── apps/web/ # Vue3 用户端 ├── apps/admin/ # Vue3 管理端 ├── deploy/ # 部署脚本与密钥生成 ├── docs/ # 设计文档（六份） └── Makefile # 本地开发入口（bootstrap / dev / check 等） ``` ## 文档索引 | 文档 | 内容 | |---|---| | [00-architecture-spec.md](docs/00-architecture-spec.md) | 架构规格：约束与结论、部署形态、服务分层、双网关、升级机制 | | [01-engineering-design.md](docs/01-engineering-design.md) | 工程设计：目录树、分层依赖规则、模块接口、装配与编排 | | [02-data-model-and-api.md](docs/02-data-model-and-api.md) | 数据模型与 API：MongoDB 集合字段、公开 HTTP 路由表 | | [03-kernel-contract.md](docs/03-kernel-contract.md) | 内核契约：双网关端点与签名方案、宿主协议、版本锁 | | [04-localagent-protocol.md](docs/04-localagent-protocol.md) | 本地 Agent 协议：配对流程、帧级字段、连接状态机 | | [05-spec-compliance.md](docs/05-spec-compliance.md) | 合规登记：约束落点与检测手段 | ## 社区讨论 欢迎扫码加入微信群「dsh 企业应用开发技术」，一起交流企业级 Agent 平台架构、DSH 内核与本地工具执行的落地实践：

## License [MIT](LICENSE) © ZY-Agents Contributors

plugins.readme_text: # @snnh/dsh-llm-service-lite English | [中文](README.zh.md) > **Community plugin.** Maintained by [snnh](https://github.com/snnh). It is not > an official DeepSeek package: DeepSeek neither publishes nor supports it, and > issues belong in this repository. ## Install A harness loads plugins from a profile's own installation, so this package is installed into a profile rather than into the harness itself: ```sh # From the published package: dsh plugin --profile web add @snnh/dsh-llm-service-lite # Or straight from this repository. pnpm builds the checkout while installing, # which the profile must allow first: run the command, add the exact key pnpm # printed under `allowBuilds` in /pnpm-workspace.yaml, and re-run it. dsh plugin --profile web add github:snnh/dsh-llm-service-lite ``` ### Mount The package declares itself a bundle (`dsh.bundle.patch`), so the install above also mounts its `llm-service-lite` row: one command installs and mounts, and no hand-written entry is needed. The mount is dormant — no route exists until a profile declares one. Two surfaces edit the same document. In the web UI, open **Plugins**, select this bundle, open its `llm-service-lite` row, and choose **Configure**: the page lists every provider, adds and removes profiles, edits the endpoint, protocol, capabilities and model catalog, stores an API key through the harness credential service, and asks an endpoint which models it serves. The same document can be edited by hand in the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` (`$DSH_HOME/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`; **Settings → Open configuration file** in the web UI opens it). Add the `providers` dictionary described under [Configure provider profiles](#configure-provider-profiles) to the `llm-service-lite` row's `config`. The profile patch is applied after every bundle layer, so that entry's `config` replaces the row's empty default; the same entry also mounts the plugin in a composition that declares no bundle layer, because it names the module to load: ```yaml - id: llm-service-lite name: '@snnh/dsh-llm-service-lite' config: providers: # ... provider profiles, one per endpoint ``` After the install, refresh the Web page once: the browser half is served by the client module system, so the new page appears on the **Plugins** screen the next time the shell boots. It lives on the bundle's page and on its `llm-service-lite` row, where that row's **Configure** control opens it. The plugin fills the **Models** page's adapter-family extension seats while the Host serves its settings namespace: every `llm-service-lite` provider card gets the plugin's own editor, and the section footer gets the same add-provider builder. The builder asks for a preset, route, protocol, endpoint, optional key, and runs a connection test before writing; the editor covers protocol, endpoint, credential, request behavior, a connection test, and the model catalog. The catalog is a filterable list with one expanded model editor; effort levels and thinking modes are localized toggles, and **Fill capabilities** applies the documented family defaults to fields a model left open. `extraBody` sits behind an advanced disclosure and blocks a save when its JSON is malformed. The plugin's page on the **Plugins** screen edits the same row `config`. Hand-written fields it does not render (`headers`, `imageTokens`, `imagePixelBudget`, `imageMaxBytes`, `catalog`, `retryPolicy`, and the per-model `defaults`) are preserved by every save and remain editable in the patch. Credentials are named, not inlined, in a managed profile: set `apiKeyEnv` to the reference (`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, say) and store the secret through the harness credential service, export it in the launching environment, or keep it in the harness home's `.env`. The reference is resolved on every request, and a named reference that resolves to nothing fails the request with `MISSING_CREDENTIAL` instead of sending it unauthenticated. A profile imported verbatim from OWCode may keep its inline `apiKey`. Mount it exactly once. When a composition already carries an `llm-service-lite` row (the archived [dsh-lite](https://github.com/snnh/dsh-lite) fork's `dsh-base` bundle shipped one), that row already reaches this package: install without activating it as a bundle — `dsh plugin --profile web add -D @snnh/dsh-llm-service-lite` — and configure the existing row. Keep exactly one layer for the row: a later layer's same-id insert replaces the earlier row and its **whole `config`** — patch layers never deep-merge — so a second row silently discards what the first configured; it does not mount a second instance. ### Route names Route names must be unique across the adapters mounted in one composition. On stock upstream profiles the shipped `llm-pi-ai` catalog already declares common provider names (`deepseek`, `openai`, `anthropic`, and similar), so prefer a distinct route id that names the endpoint itself — `deepseek-direct`, `company-gateway` — rather than a name an installed catalog may own. A profile whose route name another adapter already owns is skipped with one warning naming the owner instead of failing the mount, the rest of the profiles register, and a newly written profile that claims such a name is refused where it is written; renaming its route is the repair. The plugin also refuses, by name, the routes the first-party DeepSeek channel owns; see [Use this package](#use-this-package). ### Compatibility This package drives the public seam of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` and the `@deepseek-ai/cordis` service layer, so it runs against a published harness rather than a checkout: its peers are the harness packages, and the profile that loads it already owns the copies the runtime uses. The development baseline is harness `0.2.1-rc.2` — `devDependencies` pin those packages and the test suite runs against them — while the `^0.2.1-alpha.2` peer ranges also admit the `0.2.1` alpha line, so an older `0.2.1` harness loads the same package. Two declarations of the archived [dsh-lite](https://github.com/snnh/dsh-lite) fork are used when the running harness carries them and skipped when it does not: the model-defaults registration seam a configuration surface asks for declared model ids, and the `outputModalities` field on a model's info. Upstream `0.2.1-rc.2` carries neither, so both are inert there: the adapter keeps its family defaults on the request path, where they still fill the fields a profile left open, and the extra field is simply ignored by the runtime. ## Summary `@snnh/dsh-llm-service-lite` adapts third-party model endpoints: one route per configured provider profile, all answered over its transports — the OpenAI-compatible chat-completions wire, the Anthropic Messages protocol, and the OpenAI Responses API — so no provider SDK and no installed catalog sits in the request path. A profile is self-contained — wire protocol, endpoint, credential reference, request-body extras, concurrency, image input, and the models served — so a gateway, a national API, and a corporate proxy reach one code path. The shape ports OpenWebCode's model-provider layer onto the harness seam: one document describes every provider, and the route set follows it live. ## Table of Contents - [Install](#install) - [Use this package](#use-this-package) - [Understand the implementation](#understand-the-implementation) - [Further Exploration](#further-exploration) - [Model Experience](#model-experience) - [Known Limitations and Deferred Work](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) - [Dev Note](#dev-note) ----- ## Use this package Mount this plugin when a deployment wants to describe its model providers itself instead of naming providers an installed catalog already knows. The `providers` dictionary is the whole configuration surface: each key is the provider route a request selects with `GenerateOptions.provider`, and the value is everything that endpoint needs. ### When to choose it This plugin adapts third-party endpoints and nothing else: every route it registers comes from a profile a deployment wrote, and the first-party DeepSeek channel keeps its own a

plugins.description: Oh My DSH Chs - unofficial Simplified-Chinese fork of the tri-agent preset (Atlas orchestration + Prometheus planning), packaged for DeepSeek Harness. Content licensed under the upstream SUL-1.0; see NOTICE.md.
plugins.readme_text:
# oh-my-dsh-omo-fork-chs

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@tacrine_f/oh-my-dsh-omo-fork-chs)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tacrine_f/oh-my-dsh-omo-fork-chs)
[![license: SUL-1.0 (content) + MIT (packaging)](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-SUL--1.0_(content)_%2B_MIT_(packaging)-orange)](#license)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19.0%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24.0.0-blue)](#peer-model)

The **Simplified-Chinese unofficial fork** of the `tri-agent` agent preset, packaged for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh) as a publishable Cordis
bundle. Its preset id is `omo-fork-chs` and its `order` is `11`, so it sits beside `tri-agent`
rather than replacing it: this package **does not change the default preset** and does not change
which preset a session picks. Only the persona prose is translated; the toolchain composition and
the orchestration doctrine are the upstream design.

The preset gives an agent a two-mode identity and a full coding toolchain:

- **Atlas** is the standing orchestrator. It does not implement, verify, or review; it reads the
  plan, the notepad and the evidence, does the bookkeeping, and delegates every unit of work to a
  named subagent.
- **Prometheus** is the planning doctrine. While a session is in plan mode (`/plan`), the identity
  swaps to Prometheus for the whole planning session and then swaps back. A single plugin,
  `plan-aware-persona.mjs`, owns the one `deployment:persona-prefix` slot and chooses the text per
  assembly by reading the public `plan` session projection. The `planMode` service is deliberately
  not injected: it lives inside the `isolate: { planMode: true }` realm, so injecting it from
  outside would never resolve.

Around that identity the preset mounts the coding toolchain: filesystem and shell tools, background
jobs, skills, goals, plan mode, compaction, delegation and workflows. The declaration carries 40
`- id:` rows, of which 9 are anchored subagent rows (explore, librarian, oracle, momus,
multimodal-looker, sisyphus-junior, metis, hephaestus, sisyphus). The package ships **11 persona
files**; the plugin reads `atlas.md` and `prometheus.md` itself, and the other 9 are anchored to the
subagent rows.

## What ships

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | The published bundle patch: the preset declaration (`id: preset-omo-fork-chs`, `config.id: omo-fork-chs`, `config.name: 'Oh My DSH Chs - OMO Fork'`, `order: 11`) and its `plugins:` list. 540 lines, 11 rewritten sites. |
| `plan-aware-persona.mjs` | The package entry that registers the plan-aware persona prefix and the configured suffix. Exported as `./persona`. |
| `index.js` | The package root. It is intentionally empty: the bundle's behaviour lives in `cordis.patch.yml` and in `./persona`. |
| `personas/` | 11 persona documents, translated into Simplified Chinese. |
| `baseline/` | A frozen snapshot of the pre-port patch plus a sidecar that explains what it does and does not prove. |
| `tools/` | The port, verification, baseline and package-check CLIs. |
| `test/` | The zero-dependency test suite, run with `node --test`. |
| `LICENSE-MIT.md` | The MIT terms that cover our own work. |
| `LICENSE-SUL-1.0.md` | The verbatim upstream Sustainable Use License 1.0 terms, which cover the upstream-derived content. |
| `NOTICE.md` | The modification notice, the upstream attribution, and the machine-readable license scope mapping. |

The patch mounts the following peer packages, which DSH provides:

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset`, `dsh-agent-instructions`, `dsh-tool-bash`, `dsh-tool-pwsh`,
`dsh-tool-fs`, `dsh-tool-fs-search`, `dsh-tool-jobs`, `dsh-skill-filesystem`, `dsh-tool-skill`,
`dsh-command-goal`, `dsh-tool-goal`, `dsh-plan-mode`, `dsh-compaction-basic`, `dsh-command-compact`,
`dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner`, `dsh-tool-subagent-control`, `dsh-tool-subagent`,
`dsh-workflow-ptc`, `dsh-tool-workflow`, `dsh-tool-ralph`, `dsh-tool-ask-user`, `dsh-tool-todo`,
`dsh-tool-web`, `dsh-tool-present`, plus `@deepseek-ai/cordis`. That is 25 peer dependencies in
total.

## Install

Installation is **two explicit steps**. Step 1 installs the dependency; step 2 tells the profile to
load it. Both are required, and `dsh` is not assumed to be on your `PATH`.

### Step 1: install the package into the profile

Point the CLI at your DSH checkout's bin file, and forward the install to the profile:

```powershell
node "<dsh bin>" plugin --profile <profile> add -w @tacrine_f/oh-my-dsh-omo-fork-chs
```

For example, on a checkout whose runtime is `<dsh runtime>`, `<dsh bin>` is
`<dsh runtime>\@deepseek-ai\dsh\lib\bin.js`, so:

```powershell
node "<dsh runtime>\@deepseek-ai\dsh\lib\bin.js" plugin --profile web add -w @tacrine_f/oh-my-dsh-omo-fork-chs
```

This runs pnpm inside `$DSH_HOME\profiles\<profile>\`, so it writes a `dependencies` entry. **It
does not touch `dsh.profile.bundles`.**

### Step 2: add the package to `dsh.profile.bundles` and restart

Open `$DSH_HOME\profiles\<profile>\package.json` and add the package name to the profile's
`dsh.profile.bundles` array:

```jsonc
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        // ...your existing bundles...
        "@tacrine_f/oh-my-dsh-omo-fork-chs"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Then **restart the Host and start a new session.** A live agent keeps the composition it booted
with, so an already-running session will not pick the preset up; a new session is required.

### Verify the install composed

```powershell
$env:DSH_HOME = "<dsh home>"
node "<dsh bin>" --profile <profile> --dump-config
```

The output should contain a `preset-omo-fork-chs` row whose `name` is
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset`, whose `config.id` is `omo-fork-chs`, whose `config.name` is
`'Oh My DSH Chs - OMO Fork'` and whose `config.order` is `11`, plus nine `personas` expressions
resolving through this package. `--dump-config` prints the raw `!!js` expression text, so the nine
anchors appear as the `resolve('<pkg>/package.json')` form rather than as resolved filesystem
paths.

## Post-install edits you may need

The published patch ships **only** the portable preset declaration. Two things that were local to
the machine this fork came from are deliberately **not** shipped, so you may want to re-add them
yourself:

1. **Making `omo-fork-chs` your default preset.** The published patch does **not** set a default
   preset, and this package never forces one. If you want this preset to be the default, set the
   registry row yourself in your own profile or overlay patch:

   ```yaml
   - id: agent-preset-registry
     config:
       default: omo-fork-chs
   ```

   (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` inserts that row with `default: standard`; the row above replaces the
   whole config, so only the default changes.)

2. **Giving `subagent_multimodal_looker` a model route.** The bundle this fork was derived from
   carried a machine-specific `provider` and `model` route for that row, and that route is **not
   portable**, so the published patch carries no `agentOptions` row at all. Without one the
   multimodal subagent inherits the deployment's route. To pin one, add an `agentOptions` block to
   that row in your own overlay:

   ```yaml
   - id: tool-subagent-multimodal-looker
     name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
     config:
       # ...the shipped config...
       agentOptions:
         provider: <your provider>
         model: <your model>
   ```

## Failure mode: it fails loud on purpose

`plan-aware-persona.mjs` reads its persona prose from disk at mount time. A **missing or empty
persona file fails the mount**, naming the file in the error:

```
plan-aware-persona: cannot read persona "file:///.../personas/atlas.md"
plan-aware-persona: persona "file:///.../personas/atlas.md" is empty
```

That is deliberate. An empty persona prefix would silently strip the agent's identity, so a mount
error that names the file is far easier to act on than an agent that quietly lost its instructions.

## Peer model

Every `@deepseek-ai/*` package the patch mounts is declared as a **`peerDependency`**, never as a
regular `dependency`. DSH provides them; the bundle must not install its own

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-compat-plus **一条命令，让你 Claude Code / Codex / ZCode 里的技能在 dsh 原地复活。** 零迁移 · 只读挂载 · 改完即生效 · 模型自动用、用户随手 `/` 社区插件生态：[awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-skill-compat-plus)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-skill-compat-plus) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A524-brightgreen.svg)](package.json) [![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-%E2%89%A50.2.0--rc.2-4176E6.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-32%20passing-2EA44F.svg)](#本地开发) [![audit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mimosa%20audit-clean-2EA44F.svg)](#安全)
你在 Claude Code 里攒了一堆 skills，Codex 和 ZCode 里又各有一套——切到 [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)，一个都带不过去，只能逐个复制 `SKILL.md` 再手动同步。**本插件把这三家的技能目录作为只读技能来源直接挂进 dsh**：技能原地不动，模型按需自动加载，用户敲 `/名字` 随手调用，文件一改秒级生效。 > [!TIP] > ## Quick Start > > CLI（推荐带版本号，规避 profile 安装端的 `minimumReleaseAge` 冷却）： > > ```bash > dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add dsh-skill-compat-plus@0.1.0 > ``` > > 桌面端：**插件页搜索 `dsh-skill-compat-plus` 一键安装**，装完重启。装完什么都不用配——三家来源默认全开，目录不存在自动跳过。 ## 效果一览（示意） ```text 用户敲 / ────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 4drawio 数学建模非数据型图示绘制阶段… │ │ nature-figure Create, revise, audit, and … │ │ 1start-mathmodel 数学建模竞赛工作流入口。用于启动… │ │ …（本机实测：Claude 30 个 + Codex 20 个一次到位） │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ 模型侧：同一批技能进入 skill 工具的 目录，按需自动加载。 ``` ## 为什么是"挂"而不是"搬" - **原地不动**。技能文件留在原目录，不复制、不改写、卸载即恢复原状——对齐 modlens 的"一个插件、零侵入"哲学。 - **双侧可用**。`user-invocable` 技能自动获得 dsh 原生 `/名字` 手势入口（host 端 pre-step 解析，无需注册命令）；模型侧进入 catalog 按需加载。 - **热更新**。chokidar 监听 + 存在性轮询双通道：目录里增删改技能、甚至整个目录后建，都不用重启。 - **名称规范化**。`_references` → `references`、`code_review` → `code-review` 自动 slug 化；Claude 缺省的 description 从正文首段合成——dsh 的两条硬约束（kebab 名 + 非空描述）由插件兜底。 - **优先级刻死**。dsh 原生技能永远坐 C 位，同名导入技能让位；项目级导入压过用户级导入。不会出现导入悄悄覆盖原生的情况。 - **诊断不刷屏**。无效文件、命名冲突按"问题集合变化"输出 warn， catalog 重建再多次也只有变化时说一句。 ## 支持的来源 | 来源 | 目录 | 默认 | |---|---|---| | `claude-code` | `~/.claude/skills` + `<项目根>/.claude/skills` | 开 | | `codex` | `~/.codex/skills`（旧约定；新官方 `~/.agents/skills` dsh 原生已扫） | 开 | | `zcode` | `~/.zcode/skills` + `<项目根>/.zcode/skills` | 开 | | `extraDirs` | 任意额外目录（`{ path, label?, rank? }`） | 空 | 目录不存在静默跳过；每家可单独开关、自定义路径与 rank。 ## 字段映射（外来 frontmatter → dsh） | 外来字段 | 映射 | |---|---| | `name` | 缺省取目录名；不合 dsh kebab 规则 → slug 化（可关） | | `description` | 缺失（Claude 允许）→ 正文首段合成（可关） | | `when_to_use` / `whenToUse` | → `whenToUse` | | `disable-model-invocation` | → `invocation.modelInvocable: false` | | `user-invocable` | → `invocation.userInvocable` | | Codex `agents/openai.yaml` 的 `policy.allow_implicit_invocation: false` | → `invocation.modelInvocable: false` | | `allowed-tools` / `model` / `hooks` / `license` / `compatibility` 等 | 原样保留进 `metadata`（dsh 无对应物，不静默丢弃） | 整个原始 frontmatter 全量保真进 `metadata`，可追溯。
完整优先级表（rank，越小越优先） | 来源 | 目录 | rank | |---|---|---| | dsh 原生 project-dsh | `<项目根>/.dsh/skills` | 100 | | dsh 原生 project-agents | `<项目根>/.agents/skills` | 200 | | **claude-code 项目级** | `<项目根>/.claude/skills` | **210** | | **zcode 项目级** | `<项目根>/.zcode/skills` | **220** | | dsh 原生 custom / **extraDirs** | 配置目录 | 300 | | dsh 原生 user-dsh | `~/.dsh/skills` | 400 | | **claude-code 用户级** | `~/.claude/skills` | **450** | | **codex 用户级** | `~/.codex/skills` | **460** | | **zcode 用户级** | `~/.zcode/skills` | **470** | | dsh 原生 user-agents / bundled | `~/.agents/skills` / 内置 | 500 / 600 | 同名裁决由 dsh 官方注册表完成（rank → provider 注册序 → list 内顺序），本插件保证 rank 确定且原生恒优先。
## 配置 写在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 entry `config` 下（profile 层可覆盖，整体替换语义），未知键 fail-fast： | 键 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `providerName` | `skill-compat-plus` | provider 注册名（`runtime` 为保留字） | | `sources.claude` / `.codex` / `.zcode` | `true` | `boolean` 或 `{ enabled?, project?, root?, rank? }` | | `extraDirs` | `[]` | `{ path, label?, rank? }[]` | | `watch` | `true` | 热更新开关 | | `watchUsePolling` | `false` | 网络盘/特殊文件系统开启 | | `watchStabilityThresholdMs` / `watchPollIntervalMs` | 200 / 100 | awaitWriteFinish 参数 | | `watchMaxProjects` | `128` | 项目根监视 LRU 上限 | | `slugifyNames` | `true` | 关闭后不合规名直接 skip | | `synthesizeDescription` | `true` | 关闭后缺 description 的技能直接 skip | > [!NOTE] > 导入技能会进入每个会话的 `` 目录提醒，挂太多会持续占用模型上下文——建议用 `sources.*.enabled` / `extraDirs` 按需精选。 ## 安装方式 | 方式 | 命令 / 操作 | |---|---| | CLI（npm 包） | `dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add dsh-skill-compat-plus@0.1.0` | | 桌面端 | 插件页搜索安装；或 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 "/d/DeepSeek Harness/DeepSeek Harness.exe" --expose-internals "D:/DeepSeek Harness/resources/app.asar/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-host/lib/cli.js" plugin --profile desktop add dsh-skill-compat-plus`（Git Bash，先完全退出应用含托盘） | | git 直装（始终最新 main） | `dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add git+https://github.com/shuxidemosheng/dsh-skill-compat-plus.git` | | 本地 tgz | `npm pack` 后 `dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add file:<你的打包路径>/dsh-skill-compat-plus-0.1.0.tgz` | ## 已知限制 - Claude/ZCode **插件包内部**的技能（plugin cache、`.claude-plugin` 等）不在默认发现范围，可用 `extraDirs` 手动挂载；自动识别留待后续版本。 - 项目级只扫最近 `.git` 祖先**一级**（对齐 dsh 官方）；ZCode 式 CWD→worktree 多级扫描不做。 - Claude 的嵌套 `/.claude/skills`、`--add-dir`、企业托管目录不支持。 - `allowed-tools` / `model` / `hooks` 等执行语义字段仅保留在 `metadata`，dsh 侧无执行效果。 ## FAQ **Q: 会不会覆盖 dsh 原生技能？** 不会。同名时原生恒优先（见优先级表），本插件发现的重名会输出 `duplicate skill name` 诊断。 **Q: `~/.agents/skills` 里的技能怎么没被列出？** 那本来就是 dsh 原生扫描目录（同时也是 Codex 新官方用户根），无需桥接。 **Q: 技能文件改了没生效？** 确认 `watch: true`；网络盘开 `watchUsePolling: true`。存在性轮询约 2.5s，内容事件走 chokidar（亚秒级）。 ## 本地开发 ```bash npm install npm test # vitest，32 个用例（含 Windows 路径、真实时序 watch、上游文法对拍） npm run build # tsc d.ts + esbuild bundle（yaml/chokidar 为外部运行时依赖） node scripts/smoke.mjs # 构建产物直接扫描本机真实技能目录并打印清单 ``` ## 安全 - 只读挂载：唯一的系统写入是 watcher 句柄；技能内容由 dsh 官方 `skill` 管线加载，本插件不执行技能内代码。 - 产物只含第一方代码（`yaml`/`chokidar` 为运行时依赖），扫描面与攻击面最小化。 - Mimosa 深度扫描（2026-10-11，v0.1.0）：scanId `scan-2026-10-11T11-54-46.891Z-47166d49d84b`，seal `sha256:c5a95c8ed6f9b2079af39ecb487126b7814a52e362212f4104b3ae137a58cd57`，findings 0，依赖风险 0。历史：自包含产物曾报 6 条上游闭包静态误报（scanId `...3a00d7a1835b`），改外部依赖后归零。 ## 同类与致谢 - [deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) —— SkillProvider 接缝、`dsh-skill-filesystem` 参考实现、bundle 机制 - 格式规范：[Claude Code skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) · [Codex skills](https://developers.openai.com/codex/skills) · [Agent Skills 开放规范](https://agentskills.io) - 同类项目：[YTyangtao666/dsh-skills-bridge](https://github.com/YTyangtao666/dsh-skills-bridge)（首发思路）——本插件在其之上补齐了目录覆盖面（三家来源 + 项目级）、标准 YAML 解析、slug 化与 description 合成、Windows 路径正确性、诊断聚合与 32 个单测 ## 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Model visibility for DeepSeek Harness: a header chip naming the model and reasoning effort each Session runs on, a subagent dropdown marking which child carries its own route, and sidebar hover cards showing what each conversation did.
plugins.readme_text:
dsh-subagents-model

See which model a DeepSeek Harness session is really running on. A chip in the header names the model and reasoning effort of whichever conversation is open — including a subagent's — a chip in the composer dock below the composer shows which models a whole run delegated to, and sidebar hover cards say what each conversation actually did. It only ever ADDS controls: the harness's own subagent dropdown is left exactly as shipped.

## Install From the GUI, paste this into **Add plugin**: ``` dsh-subagents-model ``` Or from a terminal: ```bash dsh plugin add dsh-subagents-model ``` **No build step is involved** and there are no dependencies at all. Every entry point ships as committed source: the Host reads `src/client.js` and serves it to the page verbatim, so pnpm never has to run anything and you are never asked to allowlist a build. **Nothing else is required.** The installer does the composition work itself — it reads this package's `cordis.patch.yml`, mounts the Loader row, and adds the package to `dsh.profile.bundles` (`dsh-plugin-manager/lib/index.js:247-265`). Do **not** hand-add a row to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` or the package to `package.json`: a second definition of the same package fails composition and takes the whole web shell with it (`dsh-client-modules/lib/index.js:871-877`). Restart the profile afterwards. The header chip appears in any conversation that has made a request; the bottom-bar chip appears only once a run has delegated to at least one subagent, because a run with no subagents has nothing to say. The peer range on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot` (`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`) is the only compatibility field the runtime evaluates (`dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:289-301`): a plugin whose range does not satisfy the running runtime is skipped at boot with a warning naming the mismatch.
Installing by other routes | Route | Command | | --- | --- | | npm, the default | `dsh plugin add dsh-subagents-model` | | Pinned to a version | `dsh plugin add dsh-subagents-model@1.2.1` | | Pinned to a commit | `dsh plugin add github:mirelconstantin/dsh-subagents-model#` | | Tarball | `dsh plugin add ./dsh-subagents-model-1.2.1.tgz` | | Local checkout | `dsh plugin add /absolute/path/to/dsh-subagents-model` | A `file:` or local-path install hard-links the package directory, so an editor that replaces a file breaks the link and the profile silently keeps the previous content. After editing a local install, delete `profiles//node_modules/dsh-subagents-model` and re-install.
## If nothing appears Every failure mode this plugin has had was silent — no error, no log, just an absent chip — so here is the order to check: 1. **Restart the profile.** The bundle is composed at boot, not on save. 2. **Confirm it is enabled** in Settings → Plugins. 3. **Run the suite in the installed copy.** It needs no harness and no network: `npm test` from the package directory prints 89 unit tests, 35 composition checks, and an install probe that packs the tarball, unpacks it into a throwaway profile and executes the shipped bytes. A failure names the layer. 4. **The header chip is the diagnostic.** It renders in any conversation with a resolved route and needs no subagents. If the header chip is missing but the dock chip is present, the dock's session-scope slot is the problem; if both are missing, the browser half did not load at all. Contributors: [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md) and [RELEASING.md](./RELEASING.md). ## What it shows | seat | what it shows | where | | --- | --- | --- | | **header chip** | `model: (effort)` for the **active** Session | beside the subagent pill in the conversation header | | **bottom-bar chip** | how many subagents this run delegated to, and which models they ran on | `conversation.composer.dock`, below the composer beside the ContextMeter | | **hover-card rows** | model, effort, work done, active time, tokens, cache, context window, task, kind | inside every Session's hover card in the sidebar | The chip's tooltip also names the reasoning efforts a model offers and which one is its default, read from the live model catalog. A model the catalog does not list adds nothing: the catalog is advisory and routing accepts ids it does not advertise, so its absence is never treated as a fault. The effort appears only when one is set — it is optional on the same route record the model comes from, and a session with none configured stays compact. Presentation only. The model, its tools, and its session log are untouched: no tool is registered, no service is published, and nothing the model can observe changes. ## The problem it solves DeepSeek Harness routes a session by model, and a subagent may run a *different* one than its parent — but nothing on the page said so. Two things follow: **A subagent's model was invisible until you opened it.** Session projections reach the browser in two places, and they hold different sessions. `projectionsBySession` only carries a session whose projection store is *resident* in the client, and stores are created lazily (`dsh-api-session-controller/lib/index.js:2525`) — so a subagent the user never opened was simply absent. The list rows carry the same values under `byId[id].projectionValues` (`:2942`, `:3521`, `:3549`), synthesized from the parent's `subagentCatalog` (`:3518-3542`), which is what covers a child that is listed but never loaded. Reading both sources is the whole fix. **An inherited route was unrecoverable.** With model selection off — the `subagent` default (`dsh-tool-subagent/README.md:47`) — every child inherits its parent's route (`:67`), and that route is nowhere in the child's own log. The plugin walks `parentId` up the lineage until an ancestor records an explicit one, so an opened subagent names a real model marked `(inherited)` rather than nothing. ## Where the value comes from The `modelSelection` Session projection, which the harness already registers and already ships to the browser: ``` dsh-api-session-controller/lib/types/model-selection-projection.js stateSchema : { lastUsed, pending } (routes carry optional reasoningEffort) wire view : { lastUsed, next } // next = pending ?? lastUsed registered : lib/index.js:2114 (installModelSelectionProjection) ``` `lastUsed` is folded from each request's own `request/header` config, so it is the route the session **actually** used, not the one it was configured with. `next` is the pending selection while one is queued and `lastUsed` otherwise, so reading `next` answers "which model is this session on" in both states. That is the same read the shipped Agent Team row performs (`dsh-experimental-client-ui-agent-team/lib/client.js:89`). ## Subagents, honestly Model selection is off by default, so a subagent reading `Inherited from parent` is the **expected case, not a bug** — nothing was overridden. What differs by construction: - **A continuable subagent with its own route** snapshots `agentProvider` / `agentModel` / `agentReasoningEffort` in its descriptor (`dsh-subagent/lib/types/descriptor.js:38-45`), so its explicit model is recovered and shown in full. - **A one-shot subagent with its own route** deliberately omits the agent route (`:37`, `:118-126`) because cold resume does not need it. An explicitly selected one-shot model is therefore not durable, and the plugin says `Inherited from parent` rather than guessing. That is a limi

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: commit activity, contribution heatmap with shared selection, and a calibrated 72h release probability
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tianyicui-monitor

[![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-109%20passing-brightgreen)](#tests)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin. It adds a
sidebar entry showing a maintainer's commit activity and a **calibrated probability that a new DSH
version ships within 72 hours**.

Reads public GitHub data only. No credentials, no telemetry.

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

---

## What it does

A row in the DSH sidebar, next to Plugins / MCP, opening a report:

- **Verdict** — a gauge with the 90% threshold drawn on the arc, and a verdict band
  (`release likely` / `watch` / `quiet`)
- **Totals** — commits in the main repo, commits across all public repos, GitHub contribution count
- **Timeline** — daily commits with release markers
- **Heatmap** — GitHub-style contribution grid
- **Model timeline** — DeepSeek model launches against DSH releases
- **Contributions** — daily GitHub contribution counts, private-activity days flagged
- **Evidence** — Brier / AUC / calibration error, and the hazard bucket behind the current number

Click any day on the timeline or the heatmap: both charts highlight it and a readout shows that
day's commit counts, whether a release landed, and which version.

## How the probability is derived

### 1. Predictors

Each hour is a sample. Two features are used, both known at that moment:

- **hours since the last release**
- **day of week**

Commit volume was tested and dropped: in a 24-hour window it carries no signal (0.99× the baseline).
Whether a release is *overdue* is what matters.

### 2. Hazard × weekday

Bucketed by hours since the last release, the empirical release rate rises steadily as a cycle ages:

| Hours since last release | P(release within 72h) |
|---|---|
| 0–6 h | 74.4% |
| 30–36 h | 64.0% |
| 48–60 h | 85.7% |
| 72–96 h | 97.0% |
| 96 h+ | 100% |

There is also a strong weekday effect — the team ships midweek, not on Fridays (Thursday 95.8% vs
Friday 54.7%). The two are combined on the odds scale:

```
logit P = logit(hazard[hours-since-last-release bucket])
        + log(weekday relative risk)
```

### 3. Calibration

A monotone (isotonic) curve is fitted to the model's own out-of-sample output, so the number shown
is the observed frequency rather than a raw score.

```
P_calibrated = isotonic(P_raw)
```

### 4. Why a 72-hour window

The probability that a release lands in the next **24 hours** tops out at **77.7%** (Wilson upper
bound 87.9%), so a 90% verdict is unreachable in that window. Over 72 hours it reaches **94.0%**,
which makes 90% a real, crossable line:

| Horizon | Base rate | Best achievable | Reaches 90%? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 h | 24.4% | 54.0% | no |
| 24 h | 43.1% | 77.7% | no |
| 48 h | 63.5% | 88.8% | no |
| **72 h** | **78.8%** | **94.0%** | **yes** |

(Base rate here is the unconditional release rate over the same window used for the horizon sweep;
the calibrated model's own fitted base rate over its training window is 82.1%.)

## Validation

Rolling-origin backtesting: refit every 6 hours on data strictly before the evaluation instant,
across 1,092 out-of-sample hours.

| Model | Brier ↓ | AUC ↑ | Log loss ↓ |
|---|---|---|---|
| Constant base rate | 0.1509 | 0.500 | 0.4819 |
| hazard × weekday | 0.1402 | 0.687 | 0.4451 |
| **+ isotonic calibration** | **0.1346** | **0.687** | **0.4426** |

Calibration error falls from 7.33 pp to **4.17 pp**.

The ≥90% verdict fires on 49.9% of hours and is followed by a release within 72 hours **92.7%** of
the time (Wilson 95% CI 90.2–94.6%).

> **Limitation:** the history contains only 37 independent release events, so the intervals are
> wide. The panel states this in its footer. Do not make important decisions from it.

## DeepSeek model releases

Model launches are shown as timeline context, **not** as a model input. Scoped to models published
since the DSH repository was created — including **V4-Flash-0731** and **V4-Pro-0813** — with dates
taken from Hugging Face model-card creation time.

Notable alignment: each of the three flagship launches *after* DSH's first public release was
followed by a DSH release within **0.5 days**.

| Model launch | Next DSH release |
|---|---|
| 2026-08-13 · V4-Pro-0813 | +0.2 d |
| 2026-08-31 · V4-Flash-Vision-Exp | +0.4 d |
| 2026-09-10 · V4.1-Flash | +0.5 d |

> With only three observations this is a pattern, not a measurable effect, and it is not evidence
> that a model launch *causes* a DSH release. The three earlier launches predate DSH's first release
> and cannot be compared at all. They are deliberately kept out of the probability model, both
> because n=3 cannot support a predictor and because the base rate already explains most of it.

## Install

```bash
npm test        # 109 tests
npm run build   # emits lib/client.js
```

Place the package under your DSH profile's `node_modules`, then append a loader entry to that
profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: tianyicui-monitor
      name: dsh-tianyicui-monitor
```

Restart DSH. `sync.sh` automates the copy:

```bash
DSH_CANON_DIR="$HOME/dsh-plugins/dsh-tianyicui-monitor" \
DSH_PROFILES="$HOME/.dsh/profiles/web" \
  ./sync.sh
```

## Data sources

| What | Endpoint |
|---|---|
| Commits in the main repo | `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits` |
| Releases | `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases` |
| Commits across all public repos | `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/contributors` |
| Contribution graph (includes private) | `https://github.com/users/{u}/contributions` |

An offline snapshot ships with the plugin so the panel always renders, then refreshes live.
Unauthenticated GitHub allows 60 requests/hour; the panel shows a countdown when that runs out.

Two notes on reading this data:

- **Unreadable is not zero.** `GET /user/repos` returns **401** unauthenticated, so private
  repositories cannot be counted. The panel reports `private repos visible: 0` and says why.
- **The contribution graph counts "contributions"** (commits + PRs + issues + reviews), **not
  commits**, so it is shown as a separate row and never summed with the commit totals. Its daily
  numbers do include private activity, because the account enables "include private contributions on
  my profile". GitHub returns only the count, never the repository.

A true commit count including private repos needs an authenticated GraphQL query
(`contributionsCollection.totalCommitContributions`).

## Tests

```bash
npm test
```

109 tests. `test/render.test.mjs` evaluates the built bundle and executes every component body
against real data; `test/contributions.test.mjs` parses a real captured page and asserts its daily
sum matches the total GitHub prints; `test/core.test.mjs` covers the analysis core and re-verifies
the model's own claims.

## Rebuilding the data

```bash
git clone --filter=blob:none --no-checkout --shallow-since=2026-04-01 \
  --single-branch --branch master \
  https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git build/dsh-git

npm run data            # extract -> refit -> bundle
npm run repos           # per-repo commit scan
npm run contributions   # contribution graph
```

Every number above is reproducible with `node build/evaluate3.mjs` and
`node build/evaluate4.mjs`.

## Disclaimer

Not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek or by `tianyicui`. It reads public GitHub data about a
public account. All trademarks belong to their owners.
