```text
LIABILITY, WHETHER IN AN ACTION OF CONTRACT, TORT OR OTHERWISE, ARISING FROM,
OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
SOFTWARE.
```

## 3. 环境与机制

### 3.1 dsh 插件是怎么被加载的

| 半侧 | 加载方式 | 本仓库对应文件 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 宿主半侧（Node） | 包 `main` 被 dsh 的 Cordis Loader `import()`，`cordis.patch.yml` 把它插进配置树 | `src/index.js`、`cordis.patch.yml` |
| 浏览器半侧（WebView） | 需要 `package.json` 的 `dsh.client` + `window.__ModuleLoader__.load()` 单文件产物 | **本插件没有**：宠物页面是由**宿主悬浮窗自己的 WebView** 加载的普通网页 |

没有浏览器半侧是刻意的：少一个 React/ModuleLoader 依赖面，就少一个在安卓容器里装不上的理由，
而且悬浮窗里的页面本来就不在 dsh 的页面树里。

### 3.2 运行环境

- 宿主半侧跑在 **dsh 宿主进程**（Android 版 = 容器里的 Node），只用 `node:fs`、`node:http`、
  `node:path` 与 `ctx.webServer`，**不依赖任何原生桥**；
- 页面跑在 **宿主悬浮窗里的 WebView**，纯 DOM + `<video>` 播上游的 VP9-alpha webm；
- 插件与宿主之间的窗口生命周期走 **文件通道**：`/sdcard/.dsh-phone/pet-overlay.json`（写）+
  `pet-overlay.state.json`（读）。理由：容器里拿不到 `Context`/Binder，而 DSH 安卓版本来就用这个目录
  做双向通信（原生灵动岛读 `hud.json`）；
- 位置另有可选 JS 桥 `window.DshOverlayHost.moveTo(x, y)`（宿主注入），用于拖动跟手；没有桥就自动
  回退到文件通道（约 100ms 粒度）。

完整契约（含 Kotlin 参考实现）见 [`docs/HOST-CONTRACT.md`](docs/HOST-CONTRACT.md)。

### 3.3 哪些文件属于插件包、哪些属于宿主

| 归属 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| **本插件包** | `package.json`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`src/**`（宿主半侧 + overlay 页面）、`docs/**`、`LICENSE`、`README.md` |
| **宿主（dsh 安卓版 / 启动器）** | WebView、悬浮窗创建与销毁、`SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW` 权限申请、前台服务、`DshOverlayHost` 桥（可选） |
| **上游 dsh-pet** | 配置合并、素材 webm/表情包/字体、`/dsh-pet-7340/*` 路由、碎碎念与对话 |

## 4. 目录结构

```text
dsh-pet-android/
├── LICENSE                      # 本仓库 MIT + 上游版权与 MIT 原文
├── README.md
├── package.json                 # dsh.bundle.patch 声明；无构建步骤（源码即产物）
├── cordis.patch.yml             # insert id: dsh-pet-android
├── docs/
│   ├── HOST-CONTRACT.md         # 宿主契约 v1（文档，不随包分发逻辑）+ DSHA 现状
│   └── PORT-MATRIX.md           # 各安卓移植的适用矩阵与差在哪一步
├── scripts/
│   └── install.mjs              # 跨移植安装器（自动找 DSH_HOME/profile/bundles）
├── src/
│   ├── index.js                 # 宿主半侧：路由 / 开关 / 通道同步 / 多窗口快照 / 载体选择
│   ├── carrier.js               # 文件通道：原子写请求 + 读宿主应答
│   ├── adapters/dsha.js         # DSHA 3090 桥：文本悬浮条 / notify / vibrate / 特性探测
│   ├── settings.js              # 插件自己的设置（enabled/syncMs/statusOverlay/…）
│   ├── paths.js                 # $DSH_HOME 与通道目录解析
│   └── overlay/
│       ├── control.html         # 控制面板（开关、间隔、锚点、载体状态）
│       ├── overlay.html         # 悬浮窗加载的宠物页面（透明底）
│       ├── overlay.js           # 动画链 / 拖拽抛掷 / 气泡 / 与上游同步
│       └── overlay.css
└── test/
    ├── smoke.mjs                # 宿主半侧 8 组断言
    ├── dsha.test.mjs            # DSHA 适配器单测（token/版本/去重/冷却）
    └── status-overlay.test.mjs  # DSHA 路径端到端（假 3090 桥）
```

## 5. 安装、启用、验证

### 5.1 前置条件

1. 已装任意 dsh 安卓移植（DSHA / Tdsh / 其它），且宿主能访问 `127.0.0.1` 上的 DSH WebServer；
2. 已安装**上游** dsh-pet ≥ 0.3.7（`dsh-pet` 的「显示在 dsh 内」分支可用即可）；
3. 想看到**完整桌宠**还需要宿主实现 [`docs/HOST-CONTRACT.md`](docs/HOST-CONTRACT.md) 的窗口侧；
   只看到"文本在场"（DSHA）或页面预览则不需要。

### 5.2 通用安装器（推荐，任何移植都能用）

插件零依赖、无构建产物，所以不需要 pnpm —— 解包 + 写 bundles 就够：

```sh
# 开发机打包（源码即产物）
cd dsh-pet-android && npm pack          # → dsh-pet-android-0.2.0.tgz

# 容器里执行（node 用 dsh 自带的）
node scripts/install.mjs --list                          # 先看有哪些 profile
node scripts/install.mjs --tgz /path/dsh-pet-android-0.2.0.tgz
node scripts/install.mjs --tgz /path/... --profile web   # 只装某一个 profile
node scripts/install.mjs --source .                      # 直接装源码目录（改代码时用）
node scripts/install.mjs --remove                        # 回滚
```

它会：找 `DSH_HOME`（`--home` / `$DSH_HOME` / `/root/.dsh` / `~/.dsh`）→ 枚举 `profiles/*` →
解到 `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-pet-android` → 把包名写进该 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`（幂等）。

DSHA 的 `DSH_HOME` 是 **`/root/.dsh`**，脚本会自动命中。

### 5.3 手动安装（不想用脚本时）

```sh
PROFILE=/root/.dsh/profiles/web      # 按实际 profile 名替换
mkdir -p "$PROFILE/node_modules/dsh-pet-android"
tar -xzf dsh-pet-android-0.2.0.tgz -C "$PROFILE/node_modules/dsh-pet-android" --strip-components=1
```

然后把包名写进该 profile 的 `package.json`（否则不挂载）：

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["dsh-pet", "dsh-pet-android"]
    }
  }
}
```

DSHA 也可以在它自己的「插件管理」里从本地包/链接安装（它走 `plugin-transactions` 事务），
装完同样确认 bundles 里有 `dsh-pet-android`。

### 5.4 启用与验证

```sh
# 1) 插件是否被加载（安卓侧最常见的问题是"装上了但没加载"）
cat "$DSH_HOME/dsh-pet-android/loaded.json"

# 2) 载体判定：这台设备上宠物走哪条路
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-pet-android/status | grep -A20 carriers

# 3) 完整桌宠：请求文件在写、gen 在涨
cat /sdcard/.dsh-phone/pet-overlay.json

# 4) 完整桌宠：宿主应答（applied:true 且 error:null）
cat /sdcard/.dsh-phone/pet-overlay.state.json

# 5) DSHA 文本载体：手动推一行试试（能上屏就说明整条链路通）
curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-pet-android/statusline \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"text":"宠物在线"}'
```

- 打开控制面板：`http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-pet-android/`（能看到两条载体的实时状态）
- 只看宠物页面（不建窗）：`http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-pet-android/overlay.html?preview=1&pet=auto`
  —— 桌面浏览器里也能跑，是最快的「页面是否正常」验收路径；
- 宠物是否出现，取决于宠物配置里 `display` 是否为 `desktop` 或 `both`
  （上游设置页 → 显示方式 → 桌面 / 两者）。
- **DSHA 上**：宠物的话会出现在顶部文本悬浮条里。前提是用户在 DSHA 里开了悬浮条并给了悬浮窗权限
  （那是 DSHA 自己的开关，插件只读返回值）。返回 `DISABLED` / `NO_PERMISSION` 时插件冷却 60 秒，
  不会反复骚扰。

### 5.5 失败

plugins.description: 不告诉你花了多少钱，只告诉你每个工具往你的上下文里塞了多少东西。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tool-cost-hint

[![Listed on awesome-dsh-plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/qiyuexue-xiyu/dsh-tool-cost-hint/)

> 不告诉你花了多少钱，只告诉你每个工具往你的上下文里塞了多少东西。

---

## ✅ 已收录：现在可以直接在 DSH 里搜到

本插件已收录进 DSH 官方插件精选列表 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)，
分类 **用量与计费（usage）**：

**插件页：https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/qiyuexue-xiyu/dsh-tool-cost-hint/**

### 安装方式（按你的 DSH 类型选）

| 你的 DSH | 怎么装 |
| --- | --- |
| **桌面版 / 任意版本，想省事** | 打开 DSH 的「插件」页，搜索 **`dsh-tool-cost-hint`**（或搜「工具 token」「注入量」），点安装 |
| 有 `dsh` 命令的 CLI 版 | `dsh plugin add <你的 profile 名> dsh-tool-cost-hint` |
| 想装指定版本 | `dsh plugin add <你的 profile 名> https://github.com/qiyuexue-xiyu/dsh-tool-cost-hint/releases/download/v0.2.0/dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz` |
| 连不上 GitHub | 用发布好的离线自包含包，见「路线 A2」 |

> 注意：**桌面版（Electron）的 `desktop` profile 被主进程独占，`dsh plugin add` 一定会失败**
> （`error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`）。
> 桌面版请用 DSH 的插件页搜索安装，或按本文件开头的「⚠️ 安装前必读」手改 `package.json`。

收录意味着 DSH 的插件市场会把本插件列出来、可直接安装；安装走的是 GitHub Release 上
**预构建好的 tarball**（`dist/` 已打包在内），**不需要 Node 构建链、不需要本地编译**，几秒装完。

纯被动观察插件：**不注册工具**、**不往模型上下文写任何东西**、**不 append 任何 session 事件**。
它只监听 `session/event`，在每轮结束时整理出"这一轮谁调了哪些工具、各几次、各自注入多少 token"。

**当前范围：host 面（记账）+ client 面（对话流内一行可折叠提示，`conversation.chat.turnTail`）。**
host 面归因口径与第一轮完全一致，第二轮只新增了"把已有折叠结果送到浏览器"的通道和渲染层，没有改动任何计数逻辑。

---

## ⚠️ 安装前必读（桌面版用户）

**DSH 桌面版（Electron）的 `desktop` profile 被主进程独占，`dsh plugin` 命令对它是只读的：**

```text
$ dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:.../dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz
error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application
```

这不是权限问题、也不是命令写错，而是设计如此——桌面端的 profile 由 Electron 应用自己管理。
**所以如果你的 DSH 是桌面版，安装本插件的唯一方法就是手动改配置文件**，`dsh plugin add` 永远会失败。

### 桌面版手动安装（三步）

设你的用户目录为 `%USERPROFILE%`（即 `C:\Users\<你的用户名>`），插件包放在任意位置，例如
`C:\Users\you\Downloads\dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz`。

**第 1 步：把包装进 profile。** 打开命令行，在
`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\` 里执行（这一步只是解包，不会触发 Electron 限制）：

```bash
npm install "C:\Users\you\Downloads\dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz"
# 或者用 pnpm（DSH 自带）：pnpm add "C:\Users\you\Downloads\dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz"
```

装完应该出现 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-tool-cost-hint\dist\index.js`。
（如果想直接链接源码目录调试，改用 `npm install "file:C:/path/to/dsh-tool-cost-hint"`，
或在 `node_modules` 里建一个指向源码目录的 Junction。）

**第 2 步：改 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json`。** 用记事本打开，改两处：

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    // ……原有的依赖都保留，只追加下面这一行……
    "dsh-tool-cost-hint": "file:C:/Users/you/Downloads/dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        // ……原有的 bundle 都保留，数组末尾追加下面这一项……
        "dsh-tool-cost-hint"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

两处都要改，缺一不可：
- `dependencies` 让它能被 `require` 解析到（路径写成 `file:` + 正斜杠，或 `link:` 指向源码目录）；
- **`dsh.profile.bundles` 数组末尾的 `"dsh-tool-cost-hint"` 才是真正让它被加载的开关**。
  写进 bundles 后，loader 会自动套用它自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 把 `tool-cost-hint` 这行插进组合。

改之前建议先备份 `package.json`。**注意 JSON 不允许注释**，上面代码块里的 `//` 只是说明，别抄进文件。

**第 3 步：完全退出 DSH 进程再重开**（不是关窗口；插件在启动时组合，托盘退出或任务管理器结束进程都行）。

### 验证装好了没有

重开后随便发一轮**用到工具**的消息（比如让它读个文件），回复底部操作栏上方会出现一行：

```text
🛠 read ×1 · pwsh ×2 · ≈3.4K tok
```

点它展开：逐行的 `工具名 / ×次数 / 输入 / 输出`，末行 `注入量 ≈Z tok`。**没有这一行就是没装上**，按顺序查：

1. `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json` 里两处都改了吗？（最常见的原因就是只改了 `dependencies` 忘了 `dependencies` 之外的 bundles）
2. `node_modules\dsh-tool-cost-hint\dist\index.js` 存在吗？
3. 重启时是不是只关了窗口、进程还活着？

> 非桌面版（`dsh web` / `dsh tui` 命令行启动）不受影响，可以直接
> `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add file:<tgz 路径>`，无需手改 JSON。

---

## 0. 怎么把插件发给别人

> **推荐：直接让对方在 DSH 的「插件」页搜 `dsh-tool-cost-hint`。**
> 插件已被 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/qiyuexue-xiyu/dsh-tool-cost-hint/) 收录，
> 搜索安装走的是预构建 tarball，不用终端、不用构建、不用手改配置。

**不想搜索的话，把下面这一条命令发给对方，复制粘贴就装好了：**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/qiyuexue-xiyu/dsh-tool-cost-hint/releases/latest/download/dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz
```

DSH 会把以 `.tgz` 结尾的 http(s) 直链识别成远程 tarball 直接拉取（见下文的解析表），
所以对方**不需要先下载文件、不需要 Node 构建链**，`dist/` 已经打包在里面。

> 注意 `--profile web` 里的 `web` 要换成对方实际使用的 profile 名。
> 桌面版（Electron）不适用——看本文件开头的「⚠️ 安装前必读」。

桌面版看本文件开头的「⚠️ 安装前必读」——`dsh plugin` 对 desktop profile 一定会失败，必须手改 `package.json`。

当前 Release：https://github.com/qiyuexue-xiyu/dsh-tool-cost-hint/releases/tag/v0.2.0

---

**注意：本仓库的网页地址本身不是一个可以直接安装的地址。**

```text
# ❌ 这些都不行（网页地址不是安装源）
dsh plugin add https://github.com/qiyuexue-xiyu/dsh-tool-cost-hint
```

DSH 的安装来源有四种（依据 `dsh-plugin-manager/lib/types/install-spec.js` 的 `parseInstallSpec`）：

| 来源 | 命令形态 | 解析结果 | 能不能用在本插件 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| npm 包名 | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tool-cost-hint` | `registry` | **暂不可用**——还没发布到 npm registry（包名未被占用） |
| GitHub 源码 | `dsh plugin --profile web add github:qiyuexue-xiyu/dsh-tool-cost-hint` | `git` | 可用，但拉**源码**（`dist/` 不在 git 里），对方要有 Node 构建链 |
| **HTTP tarball 直链** | `dsh plugin --profile web add <https://…​.tgz>` | `tarball`，`host` = `github.com` | **✅ 可用，一条命令直接装，无需下载、无需构建** |
| 本地 tarball | `dsh plugin --profile web add <绝对路径>.tgz` | `tarball`，带 `path` | ✅ 可用，但对方得先有文件 |

> 关键：以 `.tgz` / `.tar.gz` 结尾的 http(s) URL 会被识别为 `tarball` 直链（`install-spec.js:16` 的 `TARBALL_SPEC`，
> 判定在 `:69-75`），pnpm 直接把它当远程 tarball 拉下来。**本地相对路径会被拒绝**
> （`install-spec.js:67-68`：`a local path must be absolute`），所以一律用绝对路径或 http 直链。
>
> 另注：`github:owner/repo` 拉的是**源码**而不是构建产物，装完可能没有 `dist/`。想省掉这一步就用 tarball 直链。

### 路线 A：一条命令直接装（最省事，推荐）

把下面这一整条发给对方，复制粘贴即可：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/qiyuexue-xiyu/dsh-tool-cost-hint/releases/latest/download/dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz
```

- 不需要先下载文件，不需要 Node 构建链（`dist/` 已经打包在 tarball 里）；
- `releases/latest/download/<文件名>` 永远指向最新 Release，不会失效；
- 已实测：该链接 `302 → release-assets.githubusercontent.com`，返回 35176 字节、合法 gzip，sha256 = `9a407f35…0a4d8`，与本地构建产物**逐字节一致**。

前提是对方能访问 `github.com`。若不能，走「路线 A2」发文件。

### 路线 A2：发 tarball 文件（对方连不上 GitHub 时）

先自己打包（`dist/` 必须先构建好，见第 8 节）：

```bash
npm run build
pnpm pack        # 或 npm pack，产出 dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz
```

把 `dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz`（约 35 KB）通过微信 / 网盘 / 邮件发给对方，对方执行（**路径要写绝对路径**）：

```bash
# 非桌面版
dsh plugin --profile web add "D:\Downloads\dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz"
```

桌面版按本文件开头的「⚠️ 安装前必读」手改 `package.json`（`dsh plugin` 对 desktop profile 永远会失败）。

安全提示：对方用非官方渠道拿到的文件时，先核对 sha256 再装（Windows）：

```bash
certutil -hashfile dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz SHA256
```

`v0.2.0` 的期望值：`9a407f35ec830b52ef40ad81bd97729563e9b09c7dc2bd6ad389c4a81ab0a4d8`

### 路线 B：发布到 npm registry（之后就能"一个包名直接装"）

发布后对方只需要：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tool-cost-hint
```

需要的东西：

1. 一个 npm 账号（https://www.npmjs.com/signup），本机 `npm login`；
2. `npm publish`（包名 `dsh-tool-cost-hint` 目前**未被占用**，已确认 registry 返回 404）；
3. 之后每次更新 `npm version patch && npm publish`。

这是唯一能做到"我发个名字，对方一条命令装好"的路线。注意 `dist/` 必须在发布前构建好——包里的 `files` 白名单要求 `dist/` 存在（见第 8 节）。

> ⚠️ 已知障碍：部分网络环境下 `npmjs.com`（注册 / 登录 / 发布网页）不可达，而 `registry.npmjs.org`
> 的**读取**是通的。这种情况下无法自行发布，可选做法：
> ① 换一个能访问 npmjs.com 的网络完成一次发布（之后更新可用 Automation Token + API）；
> ② 请能访问的人代发一次（注意：该账号即持有包名 `dsh-tool-cost-hint`）；
> ③ 暂不发布，用路线 A / A2 分发——对方体验差别只是"一条 URL 命令"而非"一个包名"。
>
> 发布前建议先 `npm view dsh-tool-cost-hint` 确认包名仍未被占用（当前确认未被占用）。

### 路线 C：进 DSH Plugin Hub 插件市场（覆盖面最大）

> **✅ 本插件已经通过这条路被收录了。** 下面保留完整过程作为参考。
> 实际生效的是 **awesome-dsh-plugin**（DSH 市场 `dshmarket` 的唯一数据源），不是 dsh-plugin.org。

**已完成的收录事实**（可作为同行的操作参照）：

1. 收录源仓库：[awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)，
   条目放在 `data/plugins/`，**文件名必须是 `owner__repo.yml`**（仓库带子目录时用 `--子路径`）；
2. 提交的 PR：[#7843](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/7843)，已合并；
3. 条目内容（这就是本插件现在用的 7 行）：

```yaml
url: https://github.com/qiyuexue-xiyu/dsh-tool-cost-hint
name: qiyuexue-xiyu/dsh-tool-cost-hint
category: usage
description:
  en: 'Per-turn tool cost line in the chat stream: ...'
  zh: '每轮对话结束后在回复底部追加一行可折叠提示：...'
tarball: https://github.com/qiyuexue-xiyu/dsh-tool-cost-hint/releases/download/v0.2.0/dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz
```

4. 收录后 `https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/plugins.json` 的 `count` 增加、条目出现，DSH 内置市场随之可见。

提交时遇到的两个坑，记下来省得再踩：

- **不能直接往对方仓库推分支*

plugins.description: model proxy plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-proxy

English | [中文](README_zh.md)

Route DeepSeek Harness **model API requests** through a proxy so third-party overseas
model providers work from mainland China, while **requests outside the domains you list stay
direct** — web search, page fetching, MCP servers and tool calls are not proxied unless you
add their domains.

- Does not patch any harness file; uninstalling restores the original behaviour exactly
- **System proxy**, **custom proxy** (`http` / `https` / `socks4` / `socks4a` / `socks5` / `socks5h`), or env-based
- **Global** or **per-domain** routing; domain rules accept exact hosts, wildcards and suffixes
- Three safety guarantees that configuration cannot loosen (below)

---

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:recyvan/dsh-model-proxy
```

Restart DSH afterwards — the host half loads inside the harness process.

Requires **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or newer**. The settings page is generated by the host from the
plugin's `Config` schema (`0.2.x` removed the `settings` service and the client-side
`settingsScope` service), so older harnesses are rejected at install time.

---

## Configure

Open **Settings — Model Proxy** (its own page in the settings sidebar).

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Mode | `rule` (recommended) / `system` / `custom` / `off` |
| Proxy protocol | http / https / socks5 / socks5h / socks4 |
| Proxy address | `socks5h://127.0.0.1:7890`, or just `127.0.0.1:7890` (scheme filled in from the protocol field) |
| Proxy only these domains | empty = built-in preset; filled = proxy only these (comma separated, `*.openai.com`, `.aiplatform.googleapis.com`) |
| Exclude domains | always direct, highest priority |

Changes take effect on the next request — no restart.

### Three common setups

**A. Clash / V2Ray on `127.0.0.1:7890`, overseas APIs only**
Mode = `rule`, protocol = `http`, address = `127.0.0.1:7890`, leave the domain list empty.
The preset sends OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini / xAI / Groq / OpenRouter and similar through
the proxy, and keeps DeepSeek, DashScope, Zhipu, Kimi and other mainland providers direct.

**B. Follow the Windows system proxy**
Mode = `system`. The plugin re-reads
`HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings` every 30 s and follows
changes made in Windows.

**C. Everything through the proxy, a few exceptions**
Mode = `custom`, fill the address, list the exceptions under "Exclude domains".

### Notes for overseas APIs from mainland China

- **DNS poisoning**: prefer `socks5h` (DNS resolved by the proxy), or let your proxy client
  take over DNS.
- **Plaintext `http` is refused by default** — an API key must not travel over a proxy in
  clear text. Tick the option on the settings page if you really need it.
- The proxy must listen on loopback; enable the local/LAN listener in your proxy client.

---

## Verify

1. The settings page shows live status: `path A · exit route · N rules · proxied x / direct y`.
2. `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/dsh-model-proxy/status` returns the same snapshot as JSON
   (loopback / same-origin only).
3. In a source checkout: `npm test` (= `node test/run-all.mjs`). The suite ships with the
   repository, not with the npm package, and needs no install — it resolves the host's own
   `undici` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` from your DSH profile (or `DSH_HOME`).

---

## Safety guarantees

These hold regardless of configuration, and are what the rules engine checks first:

1. **Forced direct** — loopback, private ranges (`10/8`, `172.16/12`, `192.168/16`,
   `169.254/16`, `fc00::/7` — `localhost` and `.local`/`.lan`/`.internal` style names never go
   through a proxy. User rules can add entries but cannot remove these.
2. **Plaintext gate** — a model request that is not `https` is rejected before any socket is
   opened, unless the option is explicitly enabled (the page then shows a standing warning).
3. **Data minimisation** — the plugin passes request and response bodies through as streams;
   it never parses them, never writes them to disk, and never reads `Authorization` or any
   provider API key. Default logging records the exit id and error class only — no hostnames,
   no paths, no bodies.

A failed exit falls back to **direct**, never to another exit: silently moving traffic to a
different exit would change the outbound identity without the user noticing. The fallback is
logged and shown on the settings page, so a degraded state is visible rather than silent.

---

## Development

```
lib/index.js       Cordis host entry — the only file that touches the harness API
lib/client.js      settings page (`__ModuleLoader__` browser entry)
lib/core/*         pure logic, no harness dependency, independently testable
test/run-all.mjs   test suite: pure-logic groups, then entry-file smoke tests
```

`undici` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` are both **peers** — the harness already ships them,
and installing a second copy would mean two dispatcher/`Schema` instances. The `devDependencies`
entries exist only so `npm test` can run outside DSH; the suite itself prefers the host's copies.

---

## Limitations

- Covers requests issued through **`fetch`** — in practice every model request, plus any
  other `fetch` traffic whose domain you add to the proxy list. `transport: websocket` streaming
  and provider native-SDK channels (e.g. Amazon Bedrock) do not pass through `fetch` and cannot be
  proxied here — use the harness's built-in environment-variable proxy for those. Web page
  fetching is in the same category: the harness's fetch tool builds its own `undici` agent, so
  domain rules never see it.
- Routing is by **domain**. A domain that serves both a model API and other traffic sends all
  of it through the proxy; list such domains under "Exclude domains".
- Proxy credentials can only be embedded in the proxy address (`http://user:pass@host:port`),
  which stores them in plain text in settings. Prefer letting the proxy accept loopback
  connections without authentication.
- Only a single-hop proxy is fully wired; the multi-hop chain interface exists in
  `lib/core/dispatcher.js` but only the first hop is handed to undici.

---

## Uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> remove dsh-model-proxy
dsh --profile <your-profile>
```

After removal DSH is fully direct again — no configuration residue, no listening port.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Nushell as the only shell for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): every shell call runs nu, foreign shells are refused before they spawn, and the model is taught Nushell.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-nu

[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered_by-dsh-4D6BFE?style=flat-square&logo=deepseek&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [![](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-nu.svg?style=flat-square)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-nu)

English | [中文](docs/zh/README.md)

dsh-nu forces DeepSeek Harness to run every shell command in Nushell, with the `bash` / `pwsh` executors disabled. It does three things:

- **Swap the executor**: Through the low-level extension point DeepSeek Harness exposes, it replaces the `bash` / `pwsh` executor with a Nushell executor at runtime (commands run as `nu --no-config-file -c "<command>"`). dsh still sees the same `bash` / `pwsh` tool with the same calling convention, so the Nushell executor plugs into dsh and stays compatible with every other plugin and feature. The oddity is cosmetic: the model calls a tool named `bash` / `pwsh` and passes it Nushell script.
- **Teach the model**: It adds a short Nushell rules section and syntax guide to the system prompt. That teaching text costs some context but matters: with it turned off, the model hits frequent errors when calling the shell tool.
- **Refuse handoffs**: When a Nushell command hands work to another shell, the guard refuses it before a process starts. Bash and PowerShell syntax that Nushell rejects or silently misreads is refused by the syntax rules, with the Nushell spelling in the error.

## Status

0.6.1 is published on npm. dsh `0.2.1-rc.2` and Nushell `0.115.1` are the tested pair, recorded in `package.json` under `testedWith`.

## Compatibility

dsh-nu supports only that pair. The peer ranges cover the dsh family, and boot logs a warning if the installed dsh or Nushell differs. Other versions have not been tested.

## Install

Requires Node 22.19+, `pnpm` on `PATH` (the `dsh plugin` installer runs it), dsh `0.2.1-rc.2`, and Nushell `0.115.1` on `PATH`.

Add the bundle to a dsh profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile tui add dsh-nu@0.6.1
```

Use `--profile web` for the browser app. The first `dsh plugin` call creates the profile; the bundle's patch disables the platform shell executors and mounts the Nushell executor and teaching layer. Start the profile with `dsh tui` (or `dsh web`).

If pnpm reports `ERR_PNPM_NO_MATURE_MATCHING_VERSION` for a fresh release, it is applying `minimumReleaseAge`. Wait for the cutoff, or add `--config.minimumReleaseAge=0` to the same command.

## Development

The repository ships a flake with the tested Node and Nushell versions:

```sh
nix develop
```

Inside the shell, or with your own Node 24 and Nushell 0.115.1:

```sh
npm install
node dev/link-peers.mjs --root <dsh-install-root>
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build
```

`dev/link-peers.mjs` links the dsh peer packages into `node_modules`, so the tests can drive the real seams without publishing.

The suite runs on Node 24. The package allows Node 22.19 and newer, but versions other than 24 are untested.

Real-model teaching evals are separate from `npm test`; see [`eval/README.md`](./eval/README.md) for the three-arm harness, cross-model judging, and the dated results.

## Nix

dsh-nu does not package dsh itself. This flake builds the plugin from the checkout, and the dsh installation comes from a flake that packages it. The complete example below uses `nur-ryan4yin`, whose `dsh` also provides the `withPlugins` wrapper that applies bundle patches:

```nix
{
  inputs = {
    nixpkgs.url = "github:NixOS/nixpkgs/nixos-unstable";
    # dsh itself, plus its withPlugins wrapper.
    nur-ryan4yin = {
      url = "github:ryan4yin/nur-packages";
      inputs.nixpkgs.follows = "nixpkgs";
    };
    # The bundle, built from this repository's flake. Its nixpkgs is not
    # followed: that pin supplies the tested Nushell.
    dsh-nu.url = "github:ryan4yin/dsh-nu";
  };

  outputs = { self, nixpkgs, nur-ryan4yin, dsh-nu }:
    let
      system = "x86_64-linux";
      pkgs = nixpkgs.legacyPackages.${system};

      # dsh from nur-ryan4yin; withPlugins applies the bundle patch.
      dsh = nur-ryan4yin.packages.${system}.dsh;
      dshWithNu = dsh.withPlugins [
        (dsh-nu.lib.mkDshNuPackage { inherit pkgs dsh; })
      ];
    in {
      packages.${system}.default = dshWithNu;

      # Install `dshWithNu` wherever dsh would go, for example:
      #   environment.systemPackages = [ dshWithNu ];
      #   home.packages = [ dshWithNu ];
    };
}
```

`nix build` produces that `dsh` binary. `mkDshNuPackage` needs only the dsh installation's `@deepseek-ai` peer packages, so `llm-agents.nix`'s dsh works there too; applying the bundle still needs a wrapper that adds `--patch`, which `nur-ryan4yin`'s `withPlugins` provides. Bump the bundle with `nix flake update dsh-nu`.

## Configuration

The bundle's patch mounts one executor row and one teaching row; a profile patch overrides either by id. This profile patch spells out every field and its default:

```yaml
- id: nu-executor
  name: dsh-nu/executor
  config:
    nuPath: ""
    nuArgs: ["--no-config-file", "-c"]
    timeoutMs: 60000
    enforceNushellOnly: true
    syntaxLint: true
    syntaxHints: true
    requireNu: true
    verifyNu: true
    verifyTimeoutMs: 10000
    foreignShellAllowlist: []

- id: nu-teaching
  name: dsh-nu/teaching
  config:
    guide: full          # full | compact | off
    rules: true
    rewriteToolDescriptions: true
    toolNames: ["bash", "pwsh"]
```

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `nuPath` | `$DSH_NU_PATH`, then `nu` | Nushell executable: field, then environment, then PATH |
| `nuArgs` | `["--no-config-file","-c"]` | Argv prefix; the command is appended last, so it must end with `-c` or `--commands` |
| `enforceNushellOnly` | `true` | Refuse handing the command to another shell |
| `foreignShellAllowlist` | `[]` | Regexes exempt from both preflight checks; each must match the whole command |
| `syntaxLint` | `true` | Refuse bash/PowerShell syntax before spawning |
| `syntaxHints` | `true` | Append one `Nushell hint (…)` for a recognized failure or deprecation warning, including exit 0 |
| `guide` | `full` | Prompt guide: `full`, `compact`, or `off` |
| `rules` | `true` | Prepend the shell-rules section |
| `rewriteToolDescriptions` | `true` | Replace the shell claims in the `bash` / `pwsh` tool descriptions, keeping the host's own contract text |
| `toolNames` | `["bash","pwsh"]` | Tool schemas whose shell text is rewritten |
| `timeoutMs` | `60000` | Default per-call timeout; `maxTimeoutMs` caps overrides |
| `requireNu` / `verifyNu` | `true` / `true` | Fail boot when `nu` cannot be resolved, reports no version, or cannot run the preflight |
| `verifyTimeoutMs` | `10000` | Bound for that probe |

Both checks read Nushell's parser through two read-only probes on a private temporary script. Boot runs a token and diagnostic canary once when `verifyNu` is on and either check is enabled: with `requireNu` (the default) a failure fails boot, and with `requireNu: false` each call is refused instead of running without the check (fail closed). The error names `enforceNushellOnly: false` and `syntaxLint: false` as the escape hatches and points at the tested Nushell version.

Choose the guide by goal:

- `off` disables the guide only; the rules stay on unless `rules: false`. It is a diagnostic baseline: the eval recorded many preflight refusals and extra retries, so do not use it in normal sessions.
- `compact` covers the common idioms and uses fewer prompt tokens. It handled most eval samples without a refusal.
- `full` keeps the detailed syntax reference for uncommon syntax and edge cases.

Sandbox budgets (`cwd`, `timeoutMs`, …) stay on the `nu-executor` row, not in dsh's shared `shell` settings namespace. Override any row by id in the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`. `examples/preset-nu-shell.md` lists the preset-level shell bypasses to disable.

## What "only Nushell" does not cover

The guard is not a sandbox: it checks command positions it can read, and everything else is out of reach.

- A shell name inside a plain quoted string is data, not a command position: `'bash -c "echo hi"'` evaluates to a string, it does not run bash. `$"…"` and `$'…'` interp

# dbk-handoff [![skills.sh](https://skills.sh/b/DBinK/dbk-handoff)](https://skills.sh/DBinK/dbk-handoff) [![Agent Skills](https://img.shields.io/badge/Agent_Skills-Standard-black)](https://agentskills.io) [![Protocol](https://img.shields.io/badge/Handoff_Protocol-v1-blue)](ARCHITECTURE.md) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE) > **跨 AI Agent 的通用上下文交接与需求交付基线协议** 在 Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf、OpenHands、Antigravity、pi 等工具之间切换或新开会话时，新 Agent 往往缺少前序上下文：要么全仓盲目搜索、重复踩已排除的坑，要么面对长篇 PRD/技术方案丢失全局坐标、拿完指令直接无脑开改。 `dbk-handoff` 是一套纯文件、免后端的标准化交接协议：发出端归档高密度快照，接收端受控接手，全程零服务依赖。 --- ## 工作流程 ```mermaid sequenceDiagram autonumber actor User as 用户 (Human) participant AgentA as Agent A (当前会话) participant AgentB as Agent B (接手会话) User->>AgentA: 触发交接（/dbk-handoff） Note over AgentA: 归档快照至 .agent/handoff/ AgentA-->>User: 输出一键复制的 Prompt User->>AgentB: 粘贴 Prompt Note over AgentB: 读取快照恢复上下文 AgentB-->>User: 汇报现状与计划，等待确认 User->>AgentB: 确认后继续执行 ``` --- ## 快速上手 ### 1. 安装 ```bash npx skills add DBinK/dbk-handoff -g -y ``` ### 2. 两步完成交接 1. **发出交接（Agent A）**：在当前窗口告诉 Agent `做个交接`（有 PRD 时可说 `对照 prd.md 做交接`）。它会在 `.agent/handoff/` 生成快照并输出一段引导 Prompt。 2. **接手任务（Agent B）**：在新窗口直接粘贴引导 Prompt。接手 Agent 会调用 `dbk-pickup` 汇报理解并**停下来等待确认**，你确认后再开干。
📋 点击展开：粘贴给 Agent B 的引导 Prompt 示例 ````text --- [请复制以下内容发送给接手 Agent] --- 我需要将以下开发任务交接给你继续推进： - **任务目标**：完成鉴权模块重构与测试闭环 - **当前进度**：对照需求文档已完成 [2/4]，正处于第 3 项（RBAC 中间件编写中） - **项目目录**：/Users/binn/it/my-project - **交接报告**：/Users/binn/it/my-project/.agent/handoff/261022-1030-auth-refactor.md **接手要求**： 1. 请先确认已安装 `dbk-pickup` skill，未安装时先运行 `npx skills add DBinK/dbk-handoff -g -y`。 2. 调用 `dbk-pickup` 读取交接报告，用简短几句话向我汇报你理解的现状与下一步计划。 3. 原会话记录仅作兜底，只在报告细节缺失时按需局部检索，切勿全量读取。 4. **汇报完毕后请直接暂停并等待我确认**，确认前禁止修改任何文件或执行非只读命令。 ---------------------------------------- ````
🤖 点击展开：接手 Agent 的安全复述效果 > “已读取交接报告 `261022-1030-auth-refactor.md`，工作区 Git 状态与交接时一致。 > 对照需求文档当前整体进度为 [2/4]，前两项 OAuth2 与 Token 刷新已跑通；目前正停留在第 3 项（RBAC 中间件编写）。我已明确排除全局 Session 方案的避坑提示，下一步计划在 `src/middleware/auth.rs` 实现角色鉴权函数并运行自测。 > 我已就绪，请确认是否继续？”
--- ## 核心特性 - **自适应双轨制（Dual-Track）**： - **敏捷自由模式**：日常开发或快速修 bug，一键归档当前技术断点与核心工作集。 - **规范基线模式（Spec-Driven）**：提供 PRD / 技术方案 / 需求单时，自动提炼**结构化需求对照矩阵**，宏观完成度（如 `[2/4]`）一目了然。 - **汇报后强制暂停（人工确认环）**：接手 Agent 读完报告后**默认暂停并等待确认**，杜绝无脑直接动手改错代码。 - **防重复考古（Dead Ends 前置）**：继承自 [`can1357/oh-my-pi`](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi)（omp）哲学，限定 5~15 个核心工作集，前置锁定已排除的死胡同方案。 - **渐进式加载防爆炸**：优先读取 1~3 KB 的精炼快照；原始会话日志（Transcript）仅作最后兜底且必须按需局部检索。 - **零仓库污染**：快照目录 `.agent/handoff/` 自动写入 `*` 忽略规则，将快照与忽略文件自身一并忽略，不污染业务 Git 仓库。
📄 点击展开：生成的标准化交接报告示例（带需求对照矩阵） ```markdown --- handoff_version: 1 created: "2026-10-22T10:30:00+08:00" snapshot: 261022-1030-auth-refactor.md workspace: /Users/binn/it/my-project source_agent: claude-code source_model: claude-sonnet-4 task: auth-refactor spec: docs/rfcs/auth-v2.md git: { branch: main, head: 11670ce, dirty: true } --- # Handoff: auth-refactor ## 📋 需求与交付基线 (Spec & Baseline) - **需求基准**: `docs/rfcs/auth-v2.md` - **对照进度**: [2/4] 已完成 2 项，1 项进行中，1 项待开工 | 需求条目 / 功能点 | 状态 | 对应代码 / 验证状态 | | :--- | :---: | :--- | | 1. OAuth2 鉴权与租户隔离 | ✅ 已完成 | `src/auth/`（端到端测试均通过） | | 2. Token 无感刷新机制 | ✅ 已完成 | `src/token.rs`（过期自旋测试通过） | | 3. RBAC 权限过滤中间件 | 🚧 进行中 | `src/middleware/auth.rs`（**当前停顿点**：类型已定义，待补全拦截逻辑） | | 4. 敏感操作二次验证与审计 | ⏳ 待开工 | 暂未触及 | ## 📂 核心工作集 (Key Files & Working Set) - `src/middleware/auth.rs`: 核心权限拦截器，当前停顿位置（未提交） - `src/token.rs`: Token 刷新核心实现 - `tests/auth_test.rs`: 鉴权集成测试用例 ## ✅ 已完成事项 (Completed) - 跑通 OAuth2 登录换票流程与租户 ID 绑定 - 完成 Token 自动刷新与本地缓存淘汰 ## 💡 关键决策与避坑指南 (Decisions & Dead Ends) - **采用方案**: 基于 Header 中的 Claims 进行租户隔离。 - **已踩坑/已排除**: 曾尝试在全局 Middleware 里直接解析数据库 Session，在高并发下引起连接池耗尽，已被彻底排除，切勿退回该方案。 ## ⏳ 当前停顿点与下一步待办 (Next Steps) - 当前停顿点: `src/middleware/auth.rs` 第 42 行，待实现 `check_role_permission` 校验函数 - [ ] 待办 1: 在 `src/middleware/auth.rs` 补齐角色权限比对逻辑 - [ ] 待办 2: 运行 `cargo test --test auth_test` 验证闭环 ## 🧪 验证与自测方案 (Verification) - `cargo test --test auth_test` ```
--- ## 组成 | 技能 | 角色 | 核心职责 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **`dbk-handoff`** | 发出端 | 提炼任务目标（或需求矩阵）、核心工作集、避坑指南与下一步待办，双写快照并输出引导 Prompt。 | | **`dbk-pickup`** | 接收端 | 按规则读取快照，校验协议版本与 Git 状态，向用户汇报现状后**暂停等待确认**。 | --- ## 目录结构 ```text / ├── .agent/ │ └── handoff/ │ ├── .gitignore # 自动忽略快照与自身，保证工作区整洁 │ ├── latest.md # 最新快照的全量副本（方便免参读取） │ ├── 261022-1030-auth-refactor.md # 历史交接快照 1 │ └── 261022-1420-fix-token-expiry.md # 历史交接快照 2 └── ... (业务代码) ``` --- ## 文档 - [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) — 存储规范、元数据全集、工作流序列图与 Skill 深度设计 - [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) — 面向协作 Agent 与开发者的约定与校验命令 - [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) — 变更日志（基于 Keep a Changelog） ## 致谢 - [`can1357/oh-my-pi`](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi)（omp）：感谢其极具前瞻性的 `/handoff` 机制与上下文工程哲学。本项目深度借鉴了 omp 对**核心工作集（Key Files）**、**死胡同方案（Dead Ends）前置锁定**与**验证闭环（Verification Plan）**的严格定义，从而彻底告别低效的代码考古。 ## 许可 [MIT](LICENSE)

# dsh-accountdisplayname-edit Replaces the sidebar account label — the phone number, email, or account name DeepSeek Harness shows at the bottom-left — and the avatar above it, with a name and image you choose, so screenshots do not expose the original. The edit entry is a new **Edit display name** row in the account menu, the one you open by clicking that label. The dialog it opens holds both the avatar and the name. ## What it does - Replaces the account label text in the sidebar footer with a display name you set. - Replaces the launcher avatar with an image you pick from a local file. - Adds an **Edit display name** / **编辑显示名称** row to the account menu, directly under Settings. - Opens one editor dialog for both: pick or clear an avatar, type a name, then Save, Cancel, or Use default. `Enter` saves, `Esc` cancels. - Both edits are drafts until Save — Cancel leaves the sidebar untouched. - Saving an empty value restores the account's own text; clearing the avatar restores the account's own avatar. - A picked image is centre-cropped square, downscaled to 128×128 and re-encoded, so the stored copy stays in the low tens of KB. - Stores both per browser in `localStorage`, under `dsh.account-display-name-edit.alias` and `dsh.account-display-name-edit.avatar`. - Display only. The account, the credentials and the profile are never read or changed, and the plugin makes no network requests of its own. ## Requirements Built and verified against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`. The account launcher and `Menu` DOM it targets — `data-signed-out`, the `_avatar` / `_label` spans, the portaled `div[role="menu"]` with its `role="presentation"` viewport and `itemIcon` / `itemLabel` rows — is unchanged in `0.2.1-rc.2`, which this package was checked against. The host half imports nothing and the browser half fails soft, so a build whose DOM has moved on degrades to "no override, no extra row" rather than an error — see [Compatibility](#compatibility). ## Install ### From the desktop app The `desktop` profile is managed exclusively by the Electron application, so install it there through the app's own plugin surface (Settings → Plugins, or `dshmarket`); the CLI refuses that profile by design. ### From the CLI, for any profile the app does not own ```sh dsh plugin --profile add github:AomiRaku/dsh-accountDisplayName-edit ``` There is **no build step and no `prepare` script**: the browser half is committed as `lib/client.js`, so pnpm never asks for build approval and the install is a plain file copy. ### Manually, which is exactly what the commands above do 1. Put the package where the profile resolves its bundles — `/profiles//node_modules/dsh-accountdisplayname-edit`. A directory junction/symlink to a checkout works. 2. Add this to `/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - insert: - id: account-display-name-edit name: dsh-accountdisplayname-edit ``` That patch layer is watched, so it applies live — no restart needed. ## Use 1. Click the account row at the bottom of the sidebar. 2. Choose **Edit display name**. 3. Optionally click **Choose image…** and pick a PNG / JPG / WebP; the round preview shows the cropped result. **Clear avatar** goes back to the account's own avatar. 4. Type the name you want. Save an empty value to go back to the account's own text. 5. Click **Save**. Nothing changes until you do. ## Screenshots The account menu, with the **Edit display name** row added under Settings, and the chosen name and avatar on the launcher below it: ![The account menu with the Edit display name row](assets/screenshot-1.png) The editor dialog: avatar preview, name field, and Save / Cancel / Use default: ![The editor dialog](assets/screenshot-2.png) ## Uninstall Remove the insert from `cordis.patch.yml` and delete the package directory. The stored name and avatar stay in the browser's `localStorage` until you clear them; the plugin writes nothing else. ## How it works A dual-face plugin whose host half does almost nothing. - **Host half — `lib/index.js`.** Deliberately import-free. Its only job is to be a Loader entry, so the host's client-module scanner reads `dsh.client` from `package.json` and serves `./client` to the browser. With no dependencies and no `peerDependencies`, it cannot fail to load because of a missing, renamed or version-mismatched peer package. - **Browser half — `lib/client.js`.** A hand-written single-file bundle, already in the `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` form the module system serves verbatim, so the package needs no build. It requires only `react`, which the shell seeds as a platform module — which is why `react` is not a dependency either. ### Why the menu row is done in the DOM `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-account` renders that menu from a hard-coded `items` array, and its only slot (`settings.launcher`, a `single` slot) is the launcher row itself. Occupying that slot would delete 设置 / 意见反馈 / 退出登录, which this plugin must not do. There is no menu-item slot to add to. So the row is appended to the **open** menu's list, cloned from a shipped row — it therefore inherits that build's exact markup, classes and styling. Appending one node leaves React's own children untouched, and the row is removed with the menu because React never tracked it. Selectors use only stable identifiers, never a hashed CSS-module prefix: - the launcher is `button[aria-haspopup="menu"][data-signed-out]`, an attribute the account component always writes; the text node is found by the `_label` suffix and the avatar by the `_avatar` suffix, with positional fallbacks; - the menu is a `div[role="menu"]` the `Menu` primitive portals to ``, identified as the one that appeared after the launcher was activated. ### How the avatar is replaced The avatar span's real contents are React's — an `` or an initial. Rather than remove them, the plugin paints the picked image as the span's **background** and hides the span's children with one scoped rule: ```css [data-dsh-accountdisplayname-edit-avatar="1"] > * { display: none !important } ``` That is two attribute writes and a background image; no React-owned node is detached, re-parented or replaced, so a later account refresh cannot collide with it. Clearing the avatar removes the attribute and the background, and the real avatar reappears. ### Failing soft Every DOM probe runs inside `try`/`catch`; when a probe misses, the plugin does nothing — it never edits another node and never throws into the shell's plugin loader. Clearing the name hands the account plugin's own text back. The label is written through React's own text node (`nodeValue`, not `textContent`), so later account refreshes stay observable instead of updating a node React no longer owns. ## Compatibility - `dsh.client.immediately: true` is required: the plugin works through side effects registered when its bundle materializes, so it belongs in the boot graph's immediate tier. - No `engines.dsh` range is declared, on purpose. node-semver only admits a prerelease version when some comparator in the range shares its exact `major.minor.patch` tuple and itself carries a prerelease tag, so any range would silently exclude a later prerelease of the harness — the failure mode the awesome-dsh-plugin contributing guide warns about. Failing soft is the safer contract here. ## Verification ```sh npm install npm test ``` 116 checks against a real DOM (jsdom + React 18.3.1): - `test/dom.test.mjs` — 40 checks: the bundle wrapper contract, `apply()` registration, label replacement, re-application after the account half re-renders, menu-row injection (label, icon, dropped shortcut, insertion position, shipped rows untouched), row activation closing the menu and opening the dialog, save and reset, and disposal. - `test/robustness.test.mjs` — 16 checks over the fail-soft paths: the account row gone entirely, the `_label` class renamed, the collapsed rail where the avatar is the only span, an English locale, a menu rendered before its rows exist, no `document.body`, t

plugins.readme_text:
# DeepSeek Harness Account Switcher (@local/account-switcher)

> **面向 SRE / 运维人员的 DeepSeek Harness 运维级多账号高可用平滑切换与凭据治理插件。**  
> *DevOps & SRE-grade multi-account high-availability failover and credential governance plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).*

[![GitHub license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/keerzzz/dsh-account-switcher)](https://github.com/keerzzz/dsh-account-switcher/blob/main/LICENSE)
[![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/keerzzz/dsh-account-switcher)](https://github.com/keerzzz/dsh-account-switcher)
[![DSH Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-Plugin-blue)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)

[English](#english) | [中文说明](#中文说明)

---

## 中文说明

在高频次调用大模型、多 Agent 并发或自动化开发场景下，单一 DeepSeek 账号常面临**配额消耗过快、触发 API 频率限制（Rate Limit / 429）或突发服务降级**的痛点。

本插件以 **SRE / 运维可观测性与高可用容灾思维** 为核心设计理念，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供零停机热切换、任务并发保护、端到端延迟探测、实时配额监控与自动化凭据治理能力。

### 🛠️ 运维与 SRE 设计特性

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph DSH_Runtime["DSH Host Runtime"]
        Vault[("0600 本地凭据库\nVault")]
        Watcher["凭据监听器\nrecord-updated"]
        Switcher["热重载交换机\nHot-Swap Dispatcher"]
        Mutex["任务互斥锁\nTask Mutex Guard"]
    end

    subgraph Observability["可观测性与探针"]
        Probe["网络往返探针\nRTT Latency (ms)"]
        Balance["配额监控\nBalance & Quota"]
    end

    subgraph DeepSeek_API["DeepSeek Cloud"]
        Platform["/auth-api/users/current"]
        Models["/models"]
        BalAPI["/user/balance"]
    end

    Watcher -->|自动捕获持久化| Vault
    Switcher -->|热重载| Mutex
    Mutex -->|无运行中任务时安全交换| DeepSeek_API
    Probe -->|健康探测| Models
    Balance -->|额度感知| BalAPI
```

1. **高可用主备故障转移与零停机热重载 (HA & Zero-Downtime Hot-Swapping)**
   - 通过重写底层 Platform Grant，实现毫秒级会话切换。
   - 下一次模型调用即刻生效，无需重启 DSH 进程，保障大模型任务流的持续性。

2. **会话互斥安全保护锁 (Session Mutex & Task Concurrency Guard)**
   - 切换前主动检查 `agents.list()` 中正在执行的任务数。
   - 若当前账号仍有并发工作任务，拒绝切换，严防会话漂移导致任务状态损坏。

3. **端到端网络延迟与可用性探针 (Active Latency Probing)**
   - 双向主动探针校验：平台用户状态（`/auth-api/v0/users/current`）+ 模型能力握手（`/models`）。
   - 实时测量各账号端到端网络往返延迟（RTT ms），为多账号最优路由提供量化指标。

4. **资源容量与配额可观测性 (Quota & Balance Observability)**
   - 直连官方资金接口（`/user/balance`），展示总余额、赠金（Granted）、充值金（Topped-up）及货币种类。
   - 支持单卡片一键“刷新余额”，及时掌握配额水位，防患额度耗尽突发故障。

5. **凭据生命周期与健康自愈 (Credential Hygiene & Self-Healing)**
   - **登录自愈**：全自动捕获新登录凭据，热写入 Vault，杜绝人工误操作导致凭据遗失。
   - **一键全量测活**：并发测试库内全部账号健康度，自动标记失效凭据。
   - **故障熔断剔除**：一键清理（Prune）全部失效账号，保持凭据池的高可用与整洁。

6. **零信任本地隔离与合规 (Zero-Trust Local Security)**
   - 凭据仅存储于宿主机受保护的凭据库（0600 权限），绝不上云、不外发任何第三方，符合企业级安全基线。

7. **运维批处理与多环境镜像导入/导出 (Batch Operations)**
   - **批量导入**：支持标准制表符行（`账号\tToken`）、纯 Token 列表、对象数组 JSON、字典映射等全形态输入。
   - **备份与迁移**：支持导出为 TSV、JSON、Tokens 纯列表，方便集群化多机镜像同步。

---

## English

In intensive LLM agent development and automated CI/CD workflows, relying on a single DeepSeek account frequently leads to **quota exhaustion, rate-limiting (HTTP 429), or service degradation**.

This plugin is architected from an **SRE and operational resilience perspective**, introducing zero-downtime hot-swapping, concurrency task guards, live latency probing, quota observability, and automated credential hygiene into DeepSeek Harness.

### 🛠️ DevOps & SRE Highlights

1. **Zero-Downtime Credential Hot-Swapping**
   - Swaps stored platform grants in memory without restarting the DSH process.
   - The subsequent model turn immediately uses the new credential.

2. **Task Concurrency Guard (Session Mutex)**
   - Inspects running agent tasks before executing a switch.
   - Refuses switching if tasks are actively bound to the current credential, preventing session race conditions.

3. **Active Latency & Availability Probing**
   - Two-way active probing via `/auth-api/v0/users/current` and `/models`.
   - Displays live round-trip network latency (RTT in ms), allowing operations teams to route requests via the fastest credentials.

4. **Resource Quota & Balance Observability**
   - Integrates directly with official endpoints (`api.deepseek.com/user/balance`).
   - Tracks total, granted, and topped-up amounts across currencies (CNY/USD).

5. **Automated Credential Hygiene & Pruning**
   - **Auto-Persistence**: Listens to `credentials/record-updated` and persists newly signed-in accounts into the local vault automatically.
   - **Concurrent Health Check**: Probes all credentials in parallel with pass/fail metrics.
   - **Pruning Circuit Breaker**: One-click cleanup of expired/invalid accounts.

6. **Zero-Trust Local Security**
   - Credentials reside exclusively within the local encrypted vault (0600 file permissions). No credentials ever leave your host.

7. **Multi-Format Batch Import & Backup**
   - Supports delimited text (`name\ttoken`, `phone:token`), bare tokens, and standard JSON formats.
   - One-click export to TSV, JSON, or token lists for cross-machine migration.

---

### 📦 安装与启用 (Installation)

```bash
# 1. 克隆本插件到 DSH profiles 模块目录
git clone https://github.com/keerzzz/dsh-account-switcher.git ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/@local/account-switcher

# 2. 在 DSH 配置文件 cordis.yml 中确认加载:
# - id: account-switcher
#   name: '@local/account-switcher'

# 3. 重启 DSH 服务即可在设置面板中体验
pnpm dsh web
```

---

plugins.description: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面打造的天光皮肤：4K 视频/图片壁纸、本地上传与自动轮播、可选 WebWallGL 场景、液态玻璃外观，以及薄荷猫桌面伙伴。
plugins.readme_text:
# 遐蝶 · 天光（TIANLIGHT）— DSH Web 皮肤插件

新海诚式的天光配色，全屏循环动态壁纸置于界面之下，玻璃质感面板、可拖拽的薄荷小猫桌宠，以及一套自建的排版与壁纸控制面板。

> 这是一个 **DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web GUI 皮肤插件**，不是独立应用。它通过 `dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client` 挂载进 Web 端。
>
> 包名 `@dsh-external/dsh-client-ui-skin-tianlight` · 布线行 `ui-skin-tianlight` · body 属性 `data-dsh-tianlight`

## 特性

- **动态壁纸**：全屏循环视频，固定在图层最底，应用整体抬升一层
- **可替换壁纸**：任意 `mp4 / webm / mov / m4v / png / jpg / jpeg / webp / avif / gif / svg` 放进 `assets/` 自动识别；也可从「网址导入」粘贴远程直链（无扩展名会自动探测图片/视频，不是直链会明确报错）；格式限制见 [docs/FORMATS.md](docs/FORMATS.md)
- **静态帧**：从当前视频抓 6 帧，点一帧固定为静态壁纸，可一键回到动态；跨域 URL 会被浏览器拦取帧
- **一眼换壁纸**：默认打开就是**统一的混合壁纸库**（本地 + 上传 + WE 视频/场景），点缩略图立即应用；顶部 `全部 / 本地 / WE` 筛选，网址/WE 目录/GLSL 是导入链接，画面/外观/自动/保存收进「高级」
- **入口**：左侧「壁纸」标签可打开；标签被侧栏/任务栏挡住时，按 **Alt+W** 打开或关闭面板
- **WE 不难找**：点「WE 目录」直接展开配置；WE 筛选为空时也会自动展开「配置目录」，不需要先找来源卡
- **ShaderToy 风格壁纸**：本地 GLSL 片段着色器（`iTime` / `iResolution` / `iMouse` / 可选 `u_audio`），预设极光/星云/水波/音频极光，速度/强度/色相滑块；编译失败只提示、不换掉当前壁纸，30fps 上限
- **音频响应**：ShaderToy 的「音频极光」预设可接麦克风实时电平；只在手动启用后分析，不录音、不上传，关面板/省电/切走/页面隐藏自动释放
- **精选配方**：5 个内置卡片（极光暗角/音频极光/电影颗粒/冷夜光晕/纯净）一键套用，`presets/` 同时提供可分享 JSON；不联网
- **性能档位**：ShaderToy 与侧栏镜像可选 自动 / 60 / 30 / 15fps；视频按源帧率原生播放（60fps 源无需设置），顶部显示实测视频 FPS；独立侧栏关闭时镜像不跑 rAF
- **动态播放恢复**：面板顶部现在显示**真实播放状态**（动态播放中 / 已暂停 / 自动播放被拦截 / 省电暂停 / 静态帧 / 画面卡住 / 加载失败），并给出原因与一键恢复；任何一次点击/按键都能解锁浏览器的自动播放限制，另有 60 秒看门狗与「页面重新可见 / 窗口聚焦」重试
- **播放控制**：取景段支持暂停/继续（刷新后仍保持）、0.5–1.5x 倍速与水平翻转；只影响视频，按源帧率播放，不额外封顶
- **画面滤镜**：亮度 / 对比度 / 饱和度，**默认关闭**；开启后才有全屏合成成本，4K/60fps 掉帧时面板会提示先关掉
- **自动轮播**：顺序或随机、30 秒到 10 分钟、只轮播收藏；页面隐藏、省电或手动暂停时顺延；先准备下一张再切换，坏文件跳过；隐藏的壁纸不参与
- **壁纸库**：搜索 / 收藏 / 标签 / **隐藏与恢复**（只改列表，不删文件、不打断播放），卡片显示类型、文件大小；顶部显示当前视频的源分辨率、时长与实测 FPS/帧间隔抖动
- **面板不抖**：实测 FPS 每 1.8s 合批更新，质量行单行省略；取色只在打开时采样一次（+1.5s 重试），不再周期性从 4K 视频抓帧；拖拽松手丢到窗外也会自动收尾，点击标题不会再自己弹到边缘
- **上传壁纸**：面板内选择图片/视频，默认上限 **512MB**（`TIANLIGHT_UPLOAD_MAX` 可调）；宿主流式落盘到 `assets/uploads/`，只接受图片/视频扩展名，同名自动加 `-1` 而不是覆盖；中文/4K 文件名会清洗成可播放的 ASCII 名而不是直接拒绝
- **WebWallGL 场景**：可选的 Wallpaper Engine 场景通道（内置 MIT 的 WebWallGL 3.0，`vendor/webwallgl/`），在**沙箱 iframe**里实时渲染 `project.json` + `scene.pkg`；首帧超时/引擎失败自动退回上一张可播壁纸或视频
- **叠加层**：A/B 两槽，预设（暗角/颗粒/光晕/扫描线）或图片（本地/URL），不透明度 + 混合 + 交换层级，纯 CSS 叠在任意壁纸之上
- **玻璃面板**：输入框、气泡、菜单、设置面板统一半透明磨砂；设置面板刻意不做实时模糊以保证视频流畅
- **推理档位滑杆**：弹簧阻尼、连续拖拽、档位吸附，走官方 `remote.session.modelCatalog / selectModel`
- **排版面板（Aa）**：字号滑杆、界面字族、代码字族、字重、行距、字距、一键复位；新增实时预览、字号/字族/排版分组和滚动上限，可拖动、右上角关闭
- **壁纸自适应配色**：面板打开时从当前画面取一次主色推导强调色（不再每几秒重采样，避免 4K 视频周期性卡顿）
- **薄荷小猫**：可拖拽、会呼吸、靠近会回应、点击打开互动菜单
- **亮/暗双主题**：两套 token，均保持壁纸可见

## 安装

```text
1. 把本目录放到任意位置，链接进 profile：
   mklink /J "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web\node_modules\@dsh-external\dsh-client-ui-skin-tianlight" "D:\path\to\skin-tianlight"
2. profile 的 package.json 登记：
   "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@dsh-external/dsh-client-ui-skin-tianlight"] } }
3. profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 插入：
   - id: ui-skin-tianlight
     name: '@dsh-external/dsh-client-ui-skin-tianlight'
     disabled: false
4. 重启 DSH 后 Ctrl+F5
```

> **本版新增宿主路由**（上传 / 场景 / 引擎适配页），所以安装或更新后需要**重启一次 `dsh web`**；之后只改 `src/` 的浏览器半仍只需 Ctrl+F5。上传目录是 `assets/uploads/`，场景目录来自壁纸面板里配置的 WE roots。

## 壁纸

来源优先级从高到低：

1. **手动选择**：壁纸面板 → 清单卡片（本地 / 上传 / WE 视频图片 / WE 场景 / URL / ShaderToy）
2. **自动**：`bg-main.mp4` → `bg-4k.mp4` → 其它视频 → 第一张图片 → 内置渐变

替换壁纸**不需要改代码**，放文件即可：

```text
assets/
  bg-main.mp4     ← 首选视频
  bg-4k.mp4       ← 备选 / 4K
  rain.webp       ← 图片也可以，会作为静态壁纸
  cat.png         ← 桌宠素材，不参与壁纸候选
```

缺文件时逐级降级，**不会白屏**。

## 兼容性

| 项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 测试版本 | DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`（Web） |
| 最低要求 | 支持 `dsh.client` 的版本（`0.1.5` 起） |
| 非 Web profile | 宿主半对 `webServer` 等注入，缺失时挂起而非报错 |
| 服务缺失 | `theme` / `layout` / `slots` / `remote` 全部按可选处理 |
| 类名变更 | 选择器使用构建哈希类名，失效即静默降级为半透明，不破坏布局 |
| 换版本 | 改 `skin.json` 的 `dshCompatibility` 即可 |
| 场景壁纸 | 需要浏览器 WebGL2；`project.json` 的 `type` 为 `scene`，目录名需为 ASCII；引擎或首帧失败会自动降级，不影响视频/图片 |
| 上传 | 单文件 ≤512MB（可调），只收图片/视频；文件名会清洗，同名自动加序号 |

### 升级 DSH 后必做

```bash
node tools/upgrade-check.mjs    # 逐项校验皮肤对当前 DSH 的全部假设
```

它会检查：客户端模块加载器与静态种子（`react` / `react-dom/client`）、启动载荷、5 个构建哈希选择器、`modelCatalog` / `selectModel` 契约、两个注入包、`slots` 与 `theme` 服务包。

- `FAIL` = 致命：皮肤可能完全加载不出来，必须改代码适配
- `WARN` = 降级：只丢某个视觉细节，页面仍正常

**安全性设计**：`apply()` 整体被 `try/catch` 包住。即使某个假设在未来版本上崩了，最坏结果是"皮肤不出现"，**绝不会让 DSH 进不去**——异常被吞掉并写进 `console.warn`，不会把插件标记为致命失败。

## 配置

| 变量 | 默认（亮 / 暗） | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `--tl-panel-fill` | `0.84` / `0.88` | 模态面板填充，越大越实 |
| `--tl-glass-fill` | `0.30` / `0.38` | 玻璃表面填充 |
| `--tl-glass-blur` | `12px` / `14px` | 玻璃模糊半径（仅小面积表面使用） |
| `--tl-shell` | `0` | 全局表面透明度，`0` = 100% 壁纸 |
| `--tl-overlay` | `0.82` / `0.84` | 菜单/弹层遮罩 |
| `--tl-accent` | `#2b74c9` | 强调色（面板内由壁纸取色覆盖） |

推理滑杆手感：`stiffness`（170）、`damping`（25）——越大越干脆 / 越不弹。

## 目录结构

```text
lib/index.js          宿主半：路由表（素材 / 清单 / 上传 / 场景 / 引擎）
lib/http-media.js     宿主半：Range / ETag / HEAD / 流式响应
lib/media-types.js    宿主半：共享 MIME、扩展名、路径包含检查
lib/upload.js         宿主半：受控上传（512MB 上限、安全文件名、原子落盘）
lib/scene-project.js  宿主半：WE 场景目录发现 + 逐段路径校验
lib/scene-frame.html  沙箱适配页：加载 WebWallGL 并和父页面通信
lib/client.js         浏览器半产物：由 src/ 拼装，不要直接改
src/                  浏览器半源码：按 region 切分的片段
vendor/webwallgl/     MIT 的 WebWallGL 3.0 引擎（可选，不内联进 client.js）
cordis.patch.yml      插件行插入
skin.json             皮肤管理器清单
assets/               壁纸与桌宠素材（可选）
tools/                构建、审计、打包、回滚脚本
```

## 开发

改代码请改 `src/`：`lib/client.js` 是构建产物，直接改会被下次构建覆盖。

```bash
node tools/build.mjs        # 从 src/ 生成 lib/client.js（改完源码先跑）
node tools/build.mjs --check # 校验产物没落后（npm run check 已包含）
node tools/test.mjs         # 纯逻辑回归测试（Range 解析、文件名安全、壁纸发现）
node tools/upgrade-check.mjs # DSH 升级后的兼容性自检（见上一节）
node tools/resolve-selectors.mjs # 哈希选择器体检：哪个还在、哪个失效、候选是谁
node tools/audit.mjs        # 静态审计：变量/监听器/定时器/Hook 顺序
node tools/check-css.mjs    # 样式结构检查
node tools/verify.mjs       # 路由、封装、清单契约断言
node tools/pack.mjs         # 生成可分发目录（默认不含大体积素材）
node tools/snapshot.mjs     # 存快照（lib 产物 + src/）
node tools/restore.mjs      # 从 backup/ 回滚到最近快照（含 src/）
```

## 许可与素材

- 代码：MIT（见 `LICENSE`）
- **仓库完整版附带默认演示素材**：`assets/bg-main.mp4`、`assets/bg-4k.mp4`、`assets/cat.png`（约 70MB）；`assets/uploads/` 与其它自加素材不提交。替换或再分发前请确认你有使用权，缺失时以渐变兜底
- 桌宠形象与视频版权归各自权利方；如果只想要轻量代码仓库，删除这三个文件即可

## 已知取舍

- 暗色主题下清除侧栏内部的悬停/选中底色，用于消灭一块无法溯源的纯黑区域
- 设置面板不做实时背景模糊：全屏视频上叠两层 `backdrop-filter` 会明显掉帧
- 壁纸取色对跨域图片会被浏览器阻止（画布污染），此时保持默认配色
- 面板取色只在打开时采样一次，不再随循环视频持续变色；这是用少量视觉变化换掉 4K 视频上的周期性卡顿
- 实测 FPS 每 1.8s 更新一次并固定单行，数字变化不会把面板撑高；如果仍看到画面本身抖动，先看顶部「帧间隔抖动」数值

plugins.description: Built with the dsh-bot plugin, this is an immersive 2.5D office game where you interact and collaborate with your agent employees.基于dsh-bot插件制作，沉浸式2.5D办公室游戏，与你的agent员工交互协作
plugins.readme_text:
DeepSeek Office

A place to work, meet and take a break with your AI team.

A modern 2.5D office simulation for DeepSeek Harness, built on persistent AI teammates and real group conversations.

English · 简体中文

v0.7.1 · Three.js + Phaser · Apache-2.0 code

Highlights · Screenshots · Quick start · How to play · Roadmap

Actual gameplay from an isolated local test team. Office models and textures are bundled with the plugin.

Create a team, give everyone a role, and walk into its office. Each group chat becomes a floor: coworkers have desks, gather for meetings, share sofas and head off for a coffee. Their work and conversations run through the existing Harness agent system. DeepSeek Office builds on [DS Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot) and uses the public plugin interfaces of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Long-lived identities, memory, group collaboration, model settings and permissions remain part of the same team. ## What's new in 0.7.1 - **Updates on newer DSH**: fix `already-installed` by replacing the plugin through DSH's public plugin-manager APIs, preserving its enabled selection and retaining the restart path for older profiles. - **Version checks and recovery**: verify the installed version and attempt to restore the previous release if replacement fails. Existing 0.6.1 and 0.7.0 installations need one manual package replacement; see the update instructions below. - **Compatibility**: verified with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2. UI styles, office scenes, game interactions and multi-agent behavior are unchanged. ## What's new in 0.7.0 - **Warmer rooms**: work studios gain desk pads, stationery, lamps or headphones, cable trays, corkboards and rugs; coffee studios gain cup shelves, bean jars and botanical prints; screening rooms gain acoustic panels, fabric details, wall lights and cabinet vents. These are visual additions within the existing layout, with the existing interface and interaction rules preserved. - **A phone in the scene**: open private and group chats from anywhere, or read web pages in the phone's Browser app. The phone uses the existing Sessions and native composer. - **Clearer conversations and navigation**: face-to-face dialogue has illustrated portraits and message-history controls. The upper-right HUD brings together the map, camera controls, floors, team and options; nearby prompts and compact activity cards support keyboard interaction. - **Updated characters**: the supplied long-haired character model is rigged for the existing idle, walk, sit, drink and exercise animations, with independent appearance colors. ## What makes it interesting | Experience | What you can do | |---|---| | **One group, one floor** | Give different teams their own offices. Each floor keeps its seeded room placement and grows work rooms as members join. | | **Meetings inside the scene** | Take the head seat, watch coworkers enter in order, and send messages to the real group from the meeting composer. | | **A team you can recognize** | Coworkers have individual skin, hair, upper garment, lower garment and shoe colors, with walking and seated animations. | | **Small breaks between tasks** | Brew coffee, turn pages, catch stars at the arcade, prepare lunch, mix a mocktail or follow a stretch rhythm. | | **A shared screening room** | Six three-person sofas face a large curved TV. People can use separate seats on the same sofa. | | **An office with a sense of time** | Local time shapes sunlight and evening lighting. Plants, gardens and the surrounding city complete the setting. | | **Chats and a browser in your pocket** | Use **Phone** or `P` to open private chats, groups and a mobile-style web reader without walking back to a desk. | | **Your existing AI tools** | Keep private chats, group messages, memory, capabilities, scheduled tasks and usage statistics. Real work takes priority over leisure animations. | The meeting-room wall display opens the group's complete conversation, including history and live replies. Short speech bubbles show recent messages above the speaker; the chat panel keeps the full text and attachments. ## A look inside
Meet around the same table

Your head seat, eight member chairs and orderly standing places for the rest of the team. 		Keep the whole conversation in view

The wall display and meeting pane reuse the same group chat, history and message input.
Visit another team's floor

Step into the lift, pick a destination, and travel through a door-and-fade transition. 		Save a seat for a break

Three evenly spaced sofa rows provide 18 seats. The TV currently shows a static cinema illustration.
Screenshots record working development builds; room arrangements vary by group. Click an image for the full view. ## Quick start ### 1. Prepare Harness - Install DeepSeek Harness. The development harness is pinned to **`0.2.0-rc.2`**; current office checks use an isolated Web profile on Windows. - Configure a model for your AI teammates. Chat and optional AI appearance/theme design use those model settings. - Use a desktop browser or Harness Desktop with WebGL available. **Godot and Blender are not required to run the plugin.** > This plugin replaces the original `ds-bot` / legacy `dsh-bot` team shell in the selected profile. Disable that plugin before enabling DeepSeek Office, and keep your existing team data. ### 2. Get and install the package Use the `deepseek-office-0.7.1.tgz` supplied with a build or published release. If a package is not available, build it from this checkout. Source builds need Node.js **22.19 or later** and npm: ```sh cd ds-bot npm ci npm run build node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('../artifacts', { recursive: true })" npm pack --pack-destination ../artifacts ``` In **Harness Desktop**, open **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter the package's absolute local path, install and enable it, then restart if prompted. For example: ```text C:\plugins\deepseek-office-0.7.1.tgz ``` For **Harness Web**, with pnpm available, replace the example with your actual package path: ```sh npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 plugin --profile web add "/absolute/path/deepseek-office-0.7.1.tgz" npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 web ```

plugins.description: 让 DSH 智能体用你选定的语言思考与回复：三档强度、设置面板、侧栏快速切换。零依赖、零构建。
plugins.readme_text: # Language Guard (dsh-language-guard) **English** | [简体中文](README.zh.md) > Make the DSH agent think and answer in the language you choose — Simplified Chinese by default, three strength levels, effective on the next message, zero dependencies, no build step. --- ## Table of Contents - [Why you need it](#why-you-need-it) - [What it does](#what-it-does) - [Install](#install) - [Strength levels](#strength-levels) - [Configuration](#configuration) - [Automatic language mode](#automatic-language-mode) - [Settings panel and quick language switch](#settings-panel-and-quick-language-switch) - [The `/language` slash command](#the-language-slash-command) - [Verifying that the constraint reached the system prompt](#verifying-that-the-constraint-reached-the-system-prompt) - [Coexisting with dsh-context](#coexisting-with-dsh-context) - [How it differs from the official cot-translation plugin](#how-it-differs-from-the-official-cot-translation-plugin) - [Known limitations](#known-limitations) - [Design boundaries](#design-boundaries) - [License](#license) --- ## Why you need it The DSH system prompt is assembled from many sections: identity, plan policy, team policy, **tool descriptions**, deliverable references, deployment persona. The largest block by far is the tool documentation — written in English, and placed in the middle of the prompt. Measured on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 (everything after order 50): **98.1% of the characters and 99.8% of the ASCII** come from English tool documentation, and 5.7K–14K characters separate the opening section from the closing one. The model reads overwhelmingly English tokens, and so it drifts: - The first few turns stay in your language; - as soon as it starts chaining tool calls, reading long files, or reasoning at length, the reasoning slides back into English; - nothing in your settings changed — the conversation simply got longer. A single "please answer in Chinese" line at the very top of the system prompt is enough for a short session. It is not enough for a long one, because that line sits tens of thousands of characters away from the place that actually influences the model (the tool documentation). This plugin puts a constraint in **three places**: at the very start, right after the tool documentation, and at the very end. The default level (Strong) costs roughly 146 extra characters per request and buys one restatement positioned after the English tool docs. ## What it does Three resident system-prompt sections, registered through `ctx.systemPrompt.section()`, never disposed, switching level only switches their text: | Section name | Order | Position | B | C | D | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `language-guard:head` | `-2000` | Very first, before `harness:identity` (`-1000`) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | `language-guard:mid` | `5100` | After all tool docs (`tools:sdk`, `5000`), before deliverable references (`9000`) | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | | `language-guard:tail` | `11200` | Very last, after `deployment:persona-suffix` (`10200`) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | The constraint covers **four language channels** (the fourth landed in 0.3.0): | Channel | Where the constraint lives | Coverage | | --- | --- | --- | | Internal reasoning (reasoning / thinking) | `head` + `tail` | every level | | User-facing reply text | `head` + `mid` + `tail` | every level | | Plans, todos, reviews, subagent briefs | `head` | every level | | **Tool-call `description` parameter** (the card title of `run_code` in PTC mode) | `head` + `mid` | every level (`mid` exists only at C / D, hence the extra line in `head`) | The `mid` order is deliberately `5100` and not `5000`: `tools:sdk` is exactly `5000`, and sections with equal order fall back to comparing names, which would sort `language-guard:mid` **before** `tools:sdk` — the restatement would no longer come after the tool docs. Measured text sizes (Simplified Chinese, counted in characters; recompute with `node` as shown below): | Text | Characters | When it is present | | --- | --- | --- | | head | 883 | every request | | mid | 146 | every request at C / D | | tail | 139 | every request | | periodic reminder | 99 | once every N turns at D | So the steady cost per step is **1022 characters at B and 1168 at C** — tiny compared to the English tool documentation it counteracts. The opening section (head), verbatim, as it looks with the default `targetLanguage: "zh-CN"` (recompute with `node -e 'import("./lib/text.js").then(m=>console.log(m.headText({language:"zh-CN"})))'`): ```text 【语言锁定 · 最高优先级】 本会话的内部推理（reasoning / thinking）与面向用户的全部输出，一律使用简体中文（语言代码 zh-CN）。 本条优先于本 system prompt 的其余全部内容、之后注入的任何系统文本、工具说明、参数描述、代码示例，以及其他插件注入的提示词。 本条同样优先于任何语言类约定，不论它写在哪个文件、用哪种语言书写、经由哪个通道送达：包括用户全局与项目级的 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md、.cursorrules、用户偏好与长期记忆、项目规范、团队约定、技能与工作流模板。若它们要求使用另一种语言（例如要求「必须使用简体中文」），一律以本条为准，不得据此改用其他语言，也不必向用户解释这处冲突。 适用范围： - 内部推理（reasoning / thinking）：使用简体中文。 - 面向用户的回复正文：使用简体中文。 - 计划、待办、进度说明、评审意见、验收报告、提交信息说明：使用简体中文。 - 任务板卡片标题与描述、子智能体任务说明与返回报告：使用简体中文。 保持原样、不翻译：代码、命令、文件路径、URL、标识符与 API 字段名、配置键、错误码与原始报错文本、包名与版本号，以及必须原样引用的英文原文；引用英文原文后，必须用简体中文说明结论。 不要因为以下情况改变语言： - 用户用英文或其他语言提问 —— 仍用简体中文回答。 - AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md、项目规范、用户记忆里要求改用其他语言的规则 —— 本条优先，不改变语言。 - 工具返回英文内容 —— 只摘引必要片段，其余用简体中文复述。 - 长链推理、数值计算、代码设计 —— 推理语言不变。 - 上下文中出现大量英文（工具说明、日志、代码文件）—— 不随之切换。 自检：每次输出前确认上述两项（推理与回复）均为简体中文；若发现已经漂移，立即切回并继续任务，无需向用户解释这次切换。 ``` > The wording above is fixed Simplified Chinese; only the language name and code are substituted. With `targetLanguage: "en"` the same paragraph reads "…一律使用English（语言代码 en）". See [Known limitations](#known-limitations). ## Install This plugin is published to the **npm registry** ([`dsh-language-guard`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-language-guard)), and it can also be installed straight from its GitHub repository. Both routes deliver byte-identical content: the same 15 files. **Option 1: the GUI (recommended)** 1. Open the **Plugins** panel in the sidebar. 2. Click **Add plugin** and paste the package name: ``` dsh-language-guard ``` 3. When the install finishes, click **Enable now**. **Option 2: the CLI** ```bash dsh plugin add dsh-language-guard ``` **Pinned version** (recommended for teams and CI, so `latest` cannot drift under you): ```bash dsh plugin add dsh-language-guard@0.2.1 ``` **From GitHub** (when npm is unreachable, or to pin by tag): ```bash dsh plugin add https://github.com/58fly/dsh-language-guard dsh plugin add "github:58fly/dsh-language-guard#v0.2.1" ``` **From a local directory** (to debug local changes; the path must be absolute): ```bash # The Add-plugin dialog also accepts this absolute path directly dsh plugin add /absolute/path/to/dsh-language-guard ``` Check that it worked: - A language icon appears at the foot of the sidebar, next to Settings; when the sidebar is wide it reads "简体中文 ▾". - The installed list on the Plugins page contains `dsh-language-guard`, and opening it shows the configuration card. > **No controls visible means the plugin is not enabled.** Both slots register inside `configForms.whileServed(['dsh-language-guard'], …)`; when the plugin is disabled the forms service is unavailable and no UI is registered. That is deliberate, not a bug — enable the plugin on the Plugins page first. Requirements: DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`, Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`. `dependencies` is empty and every peer dependency is optional, so nothing extra is downloaded at runtime. Installing from npm only needs reachability to `registry.npmjs.org`; installing from GitHub needs `github.com` (or `codeload.github.com`). ## Strength levels The three descriptions below are exactly what the settings panel shows: | Level | Value | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | Basic | `B` | One language constraint at the start and one at the end of the prompt. Cheapest, best for short sessions. | | Strong | `C` | Adds a restatement right after the tool descriptions on top of Basic, countering drift from

plugins.readme_text:
# OpenCode Bridge

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-opencode-bridge?logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-opencode-bridge)
[![Total npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/dsh-opencode-bridge?logo=npm&label=Downloads)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-opencode-bridge)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Vikrant-Aleph/dsh-opencode-bridge)](LICENSE)
[![GitHub Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Vikrant-Aleph/dsh-opencode-bridge)](https://github.com/Vikrant-Aleph/dsh-opencode-bridge/releases/latest)
[![Node.js requirement](https://img.shields.io/node/v/dsh-opencode-bridge?logo=node.js)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-opencode-bridge)

[中文](README.zh.md) | English

A plugin for using [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) free models in
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH).
No OpenCode account or API key is required by default.

## Features

- **Automatic model refresh**: fetches the free-model list at startup and every 10 minutes by default, adds/removes models as the upstream catalog changes, and retains the last successful list if a refresh fails.
- **Declared image input**: models that advertise image support receive uploaded/pasted images through DSH's official attachment interface. Tool-output images are forwarded with their result association; text-only models keep a clear fallback.
- **Streaming and tool calls**: preserves reasoning history across multi-step tool calls, adapts DSH's native tools, and rejects unverified conversions rather than treating Bash commands as PowerShell.
- **Optional proxy failover**: configure multiple HTTP(S) or SOCKS proxies, try another ready egress for explicit egress-quota errors or connection failures, and respect server-requested waits.

## Install and get started

Image input requires DSH's attachment request-version API; this version is built and verified against DSH SDK 0.2.1-rc.2.

### Install in DSH Desktop

1. Open **Plugins** in the sidebar, then click **Add plugin** in the top-right corner.
2. Enter:

   ```text
   dsh-opencode-bridge@0.5.4
   ```

3. Prefer the official npm registry under **Installation source**. Mirrors may take time to sync new versions.
4. Click **Install** and wait for completion.

### Install from the command line

Install from npm into your DSH profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-opencode-bridge@0.5.4
```

Replace `desktop` with the profile you use. If `dsh` is not available in your terminal, use:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-opencode-bridge@0.5.4
```

After installation, select a model under **OpenCode Bridge** in the model picker. If it does not appear, restart the corresponding DSH profile.
Normal use requires no API key or manual configuration-file edits. List changes are announced to DSH's model picker without restarting the plugin. Advanced refresh-interval configuration is documented in the [configuration reference](TECHNICAL.md#8-configuration-reference).

## Optional proxy setup

Without proxy configuration, the plugin uses a direct connection from your machine.

1. Open **Settings → OpenCode Bridge → Egress rotation (optional)**.
2. Add your existing proxy addresses one at a time, such as `http://127.0.0.1:7890` or `socks5h://127.0.0.1:1080`. You can keep `direct` (this machine) as an egress.
3. Use **Test all** to check connectivity. Cooling entries are skipped to avoid early requests. Adding or removing an entry saves and applies the change automatically.

The plugin prefers ready entries in list order. Explicit egress-quota errors or connection failures temporarily cool an entry. A server-requested wait prevents immediate failover, and a fully cooling pool sends no early requests. Model-backend unavailability and unexplained 429s are not automatically treated as exhausted proxy quota.

DSH centrally performs at most two automatic retries; excessive waits return an error for you to retry later. Replies that have started streaming are not automatically replayed.

**HTTP(S), SOCKS4/4a and SOCKS5/5h** proxies are supported. Use only authorized proxies and respect upstream service limits.

## Important notes

- **Unofficial project**: not affiliated with OpenCode or DeepSeek. Upstream protocols, models and free quotas may change; continued availability is not guaranteed.
- **Third-party processing**: model requests are sent to OpenCode's service and, when configured, traverse your proxy. Do not send content you would not entrust to those third parties.
- **Attachments**: image input follows each model's declared capability. DSH prepares request versions and applies image budgets/offload decisions; ordinary files remain text handles rather than native file inputs. Image bytes and data URLs are not written to diagnostic logs.
- **Credentials and logs**: proxy passwords are stored in plaintext locally. SOCKS username/password authentication is not encrypted by SOCKS itself; use trusted proxies and networks. Do not publish the configuration file; inspect logs and screenshots for sensitive information before sharing.

## Troubleshooting

| Problem | What to try |
|---|---|
| No models after installation | Check the target profile, confirm the plugin is enabled, restart DSH and check network connectivity. |
| Thinking mode fails after a tool result with missing reasoning_content | Update the plugin; 0.5.3 restores the required assistant-history field, including empty reasoning. |
| HTTP 429 | Retry later. If proxies are configured, inspect their status in Settings. |
| HTTP 403 or 503 | Check for plugin updates and upstream service issues, then retry later. These errors do not trigger proxy failover. Report persistent problems. |
| Tool calls fail | Check the **Diagnostic log** tab, or ask the agent to run `opencode_bridge_audit` for tool compatibility. |

For bugs or feature requests, [choose an Issue form](https://github.com/Vikrant-Aleph/dsh-opencode-bridge/issues/new/choose) and fill in the requested versions, reproduction steps and expected/actual behavior. Redact logs first; do not include API keys, proxy passwords or private conversations.

## Development and technical documentation

<details>
<summary>Develop and install from source</summary>

Requires **Node.js ≥ 20.18.1** and pnpm. Node.js 22 or 24 LTS is recommended.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Vikrant-Aleph/dsh-opencode-bridge.git
cd dsh-opencode-bridge
pnpm install
pnpm build
pnpm test
```

Build output is not committed to Git. To install a local build in DSH:

```sh
pnpm pack
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-opencode-bridge-0.5.4.tgz
```

</details>

See the [technical documentation](TECHNICAL.md) ([中文](TECHNICAL.zh.md)) for implementation details, full configuration, testing and maintenance rules.

## Credits and license

Protocol research drew on the official OpenCode source and open-source projects including sub2api, 9router, hermes-oc-free-provider and cpa-plugin-opencodezen. Sources and comparison records are documented in the technical documentation.

Licensed under [MIT](LICENSE).

plugins.description: 在DSH中实现原生的WSL体验，在桌面端实现可选择WSL的工作区并使用linux工具流
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-wsl-bridge

[English](README.en.md)

在 Windows 上给 [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness) 一个原生的 WSL（Linux）执行面。不额外启动 web 服务，也不在 WSL 里安装 dsh。Windows 会话和 WSL 会话在同一个桌面端里使用。

当前版本 **0.4.7**。需要 **Windows**、一个可用的 WSL 发行版，以及 **DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`**。已收录到 [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market)，在插件市场搜索 `dsh-wsl-bridge` 即可找到，分类是 WSL。源码：<https://github.com/TGWgulugu/dsh-wsl-bridge>

## 安装

在 DSH 的插件市场（[dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market)）里搜索 `dsh-wsl-bridge`，从 WSL 分类打开后安装。插件也已发布到 npm：[dsh-wsl-bridge](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-wsl-bridge)。在普通终端里执行下面的命令，DSH 会从 npm 安装这个包。不要在 DSH 会话的工具沙箱里跑。`dsh` 不在 PATH 上时，换成 Desktop 自带的 `dsh.cmd` 完整路径。

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-wsl-bridge
```

要装本仓库里的源码，而不是 npm 上的版本时：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add .
```

也可以在仓库根目录运行 `pwsh -File scripts/install-desktop.ps1`。装完后从托盘**完全退出** DSH Desktop，再打开。刷新页面不够。

重启后：

- 任意会话里出现 `wsl_bash`、`wsl_read`、`wsl_write`、`wsl_edit`、`wsl_path`、`wsl_env`。
- 新建会话的模式选择器里出现 **WSL**。

卸载：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-wsl-bridge
```

如果卸载后应用起不来，在该 profile 目录里执行一次 `pnpm install`。

## 两种用法

### 任意会话里的 WSL 工具

这些工具加在现有会话上，不替换 Windows 自己的 shell 和文件工具。

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `wsl_bash` | 在 WSL 里执行 bash。每个会话一个持久 shell，`cd` 和 `export` 会保留。输出以 `[exit code: N]` 结尾 |
| `wsl_read` | 读 Linux 路径，支持按行 `offset` / `limit` |
| `wsl_write` | 原子写入 Linux 路径。可带 `expectedSha256`，文件在你读过之后被改过就拒绝写入 |
| `wsl_edit` | 按字符串替换。读和写之间用 sha256 核对内容 |
| `wsl_path` | Windows 路径和 Linux 路径互转。优先用发行版里的 `wslpath` |
| `wsl_env` | 查看发行版、内核、用户和是否有 node / python3 / git |

默认有一段路由提示：Linux 上的工作优先用 `wsl_bash` 和 Linux 路径，Windows 文件在 `/mnt/<盘符>`。它不隐藏、也不禁用宿主工具。

`wsl_bash` 可以传 `runInBackground: true`。命令会登记成宿主后台任务，用 `job_output` 看输出、用 `job_kill` 停止。这个任务独占一个 WSL 进程：不继承持久 shell 的 `cd` / `export`，会话 shell 退出时也不会把它杀掉。

### WSL 会话模式

新建会话时选择 **WSL**。这一会话里的 `bash`、`read`、`write`、`edit`、`grep`、`glob` 都在 Linux 里执行，参数是 Linux 路径。persona、skill、goal、plan、compaction、subagent、todo、web、present 仍用 DSH 标准会话的那一套。

**工作区由你在当前发行版里选定。** 新建对话并选中 WSL 后，窗口从 `$HOME` 列出该发行版的文件夹。可以进入子文件夹，也可以回到上一级，然后用「使用此文件夹」确认。选中的目录用这台电脑上的 `wslpath -w` 现查，不写死发行版名或用户名。右上角的文件夹按钮打开这个目录，而不是 DSH 自带的 `default-workspace`。

按 Esc 或「取消」只关掉这一次。把模式从 WSL 换走，再选回 WSL，窗口会再出现。对话一旦发出第一条消息，DSH 就不再允许更换模式，这个窗口也不会在那条对话里再次出现。

第一次 `bash`、相对路径，以及不传 `path` 的 `grep` / `glob`，都从你选的目录开始。要搜 Windows 目录时，显式传入 `/mnt/<盘符>/...`。上面的 `wsl_*` 工具不走这个窗口，仍使用当前 Windows 会话目录。

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `bash` | 发行版里的持久 bash，语法是 bash，不是 PowerShell |
| `read` / `write` / `edit` | 读写 Linux 路径。相对路径相对你选的工作区 |
| `grep` | 发行版内的 GNU grep。结果是 `path:line: text`。不传 `path` 时搜你选的工作区 |
| `glob` | 按 glob 列出文件，旧文件在前。不传 `path` 时列你选的工作区 |
| `wsl_env` | 发行版信息 |

目录列表从 `$HOME` 开始，只列出这一层的文件夹。登录脚本如果往标准输出打字，不会被当成路径。查不到目录时，不会改去打开 Windows 会话目录。选择窗口使用不透明底色，不跟随会把背景透出来的皮肤。

## 配置

改插件行的 `config`（`cordis.patch.yml`，或 profile 里覆盖它的补丁）。字段都可以省略。

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `distro` | `''` | 发行版名。空字符串表示系统默认发行版 |
| `timeoutMs` | `120000` | `bash` / `wsl_bash` 的默认时限（毫秒） |
| `fileTimeoutMs` | `30000` | 读、写、搜索的单次时限（毫秒） |
| `maxFileBytes` | `2097152` | `read` / `edit` 最多读取的字节数 |
| `defaultWorkdir` | `session` | 宿主 `wsl_*` 工具的 `session` 是当前 Windows 会话目录。WSL 模式的 `session` 是你选的工作区。`home` 使用当前发行版的 `$HOME`。也可以填绝对 Linux 路径 |
| `dangerGuard` | `true` | 拒绝明显的破坏性命令，除非该次调用带 `allowDangerous: true` |
| `backgroundJobs` | `true` | 是否允许 `runInBackground`。宿主没有任务注册表时会明确拒绝 |
| `promptSection` | `true` | 是否加入宿主会话的路由提示 |
| `promptOrder` | `3260` | 这段提示的排序 |
| `promptText` | `''` | 用来替换内置路由提示。空字符串表示用内置文本 |
| `selfCheck` | `false` | 挂载时探测一次 WSL。也可以设环境变量 `DSH_WSL_BRIDGE_SELFCHECK=1` |
| `selfCheckMarker` | `''` | 把探测结果追加到这个文件。也可以设 `DSH_WSL_BRIDGE_MARKER` |

破坏性命令清单包括递归删除、写块设备、关机、`find -delete`、`git clean -fdx`。这是固定名单，不是内核隔离；换一种写法仍可能绕过。

## 边界

- 只支持 Windows。其他系统上这两行配置会禁用。
- 工具通过 `wsl.exe` 执行，**不受** DSH 的 Windows 文件沙箱约束。把它看成：发行版里该用户能写的路径，以及通过 `/mnt/<盘符>` 能碰到的 Windows 路径，都可以写。详见 [docs/SECURITY.md](docs/SECURITY.md)。
- `grep` / `glob` 使用 GNU grep 和 find，不读 `.gitignore`。隐藏文件、`node_modules` 和版本库元数据会跳过。
- 新建对话选中 WSL 后，从当前发行版里选工作区。右上角的文件夹按钮打开这个目录。技能和文件引用跟着这个工作区走。Esc 只关闭这一次；换走模式再选回 WSL 会再问一次。已开始的对话不能再改模式。
- 第一次调用要等发行版冷启动，可能要数秒。`timeoutMs` 默认 120 秒。
- 本插件不在发行版里安装 Node 或其他工具链。

## 文档

- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)：宿主工具和 WSL 模式怎么分层，以及为什么不替换 shell / fs 服务。
- [docs/SECURITY.md](docs/SECURITY.md)：沙箱边界和危险命令守卫做不到什么。
- [docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)：装完没出现、`EPERM`、模式缺失、冷启动、卸载。

## 开发

```powershell
npm test
npm run test:integration
pwsh -NoProfile -File test/release.test.ps1
pwsh -File scripts/release.ps1 -DryRun
```

`npm test` 不需要 WSL。`npm run test:integration` 会在真实 WSL 里跑，并删掉自己的临时目录。发布脚本的检查不会真的发布。正式发布要先提交干净的工作区，再执行 `pwsh -File scripts/release.ps1`。

代码是纯 ESM，没有构建步骤。`index.js` 注册宿主工具，`wsl-world.js` 注册 WSL 会话模式，实现在 `src/`。

## 许可证
